MR. LIU LOO-YING RELEASED

According to a telegram dated March 12 from
Hankow, Mr. Lieu Loo-ying (刘履瀛), a member of the Central
Executive Committee of the Kuomintang, who was arrested in
Shanghai about a year ago in connection with the murder of
the late General Yang Yung-tai, former Chairman of the Hupeh
Provincial Government, and later extradited to Hankow, has
been released as he has expressed his willingness to under-
take a certain important mission.

January 26, 1938. Afternoon Translation.

The Shanghai Pao (上海報), a mosquito paper :-

THE NEW CHINA YOUTHS' SPECIAL AFFAIRS CORPS

Following the arrest of Mr. Liu Lu-ying (刘芦英), formerly a member of the C.E.C. of the Kuomintang of the National Government, in Shanghai on February 24 last year in connection with the assassination of General Yang Yung-tai (杨永泰), the former Chairman of the Hupeh Provincial Government, the "New China Youths' Special Affairs Corps", which was promoted and financed by him, was dissolved. Siao Shih-yung (萧世雍) was then the Chief Captain.

The Corps was divided into three branches. The first branch worked in South China, the second in Shanghai and the third in the North and along the Yangtze Valley. The monthly subsidy to this Corps amounted to $2,000 only of which the Chief Captain received $500, the balance being used as expenses for the upkeep of the branches. Thus, the Corps was always short of funds.

After the arrest of Mr. Liu Lu-ying, the Corps lost its subsidy of $2,000 per mensem and had to suspend operations.

Of late information has been received to the effect that the "New China Youths' Special Affairs Corps" has resumed its activities in Hongkong. It is probably being directed by former members who are still connected with Mr. Liu Lu-ying although the latter is at present serving a term of imprisonment. At present its Chief Captain is one Huang (黄) who was formerly connected with Government circles and is a returned student from Japan. Nothing is known as to the source of its income.

C.J.S.
B.Y.
P.R. 27/1

1938年1月26日。下午译文。

《上海报》，一家小型报纸：-

“新中国青年特别事务队”

继去年2月24日前国民政府国民党中执委委员刘芦英（Liu Lu-ying）在上海因与前湖北省政府主席杨永泰（Yang Yung-tai）将军遇刺案有关被捕后，由他推动并资助的“新中国青年特别事务队”被解散。当时萧世雍（Siao Shih-yung）任总队长。

该队分为三个分支。第一分支在华南活动，第二分支在上海，第三分支在华北及长江流域。对该队的月度津贴仅为2,000元，其中总队长领取500元，余款用于各分支的维持费用。因此，该队一直资金短缺。

刘芦英先生被捕后，该队失去了每月2,000元的津贴，被迫停止活动。

最近收到消息，“新中国青年特别事务队”已在香港恢复活动。尽管刘芦英目前正在服刑，但该队可能仍由与他有联系的旧成员指挥。目前的总队长是一名黄姓人士（Huang），他以前与政府界有联系，是日本归国留学生。其收入来源不详。

C.J.S.
B.Y.
P.R. 1月27日

LIEU LOO-YING SENTENCED TO TEN YEARS' IMPRISONMENT
In a judgment issued at 2 p.m. October 30,
the Hupeh High Court sentenced Lieu Loo-ying, a member of
the C.E.C. of the Kuomintang, to ten years' imprisonment
in connection with the murder of General Yang Yung-tai,
the former Chairman of the Hupeh Provincial Government.

May 10, 1937. Morning Translation

Sin Wan Dao and other local newspapers :-

CHARGES AGAINST LIU LOO YING, C.E.C. MEMBER

In connection with the murder of General Yang Yung-tai, late Chairman of the Hupeh Provincial Government, the following charges have been framed by the Chief Procurator of the Wuchang District Court against Liu Loo-ying ( 劉隱 ), member of the Central Executive Committee of the Kuomintang :-

Facts of the Case

The accused Liu Loo-ying was elected Chief of the Propaganda Department of the Central Kuomintang, but did not assume his duties. When the People's movement Committee was formed in the South-West last year, Liu Loo-ying was elected a Standing Committee member. Being jealous of General Yang Yung-tai, late Chairman of the Hupeh Provincial Government, General Chang Chun, former Minister of Foreign Affairs, General Chiang Tso-pin, Minister of Interior, Mr. Yu Fei-pang, Minister of Communications, and General Chiang Kai-shek, Chairman of the Military Affairs Commission, Liu Loo-ying and others instigated their subordinate named Yang Siao-ming ( 楊筱明 ) (alias Zee Chun 徐群 , Yang Er-chien 楊爾建 , Yang Yeu-sung 楊又生 , Yang Pah-kwang 楊伯光 , Yang Chi-cheng 楊其貞 and Zee Chao 徐超 ) to form an assassination organization in Shanghai. Owing to lack of opportunity in Shanghai, the organization was enlarged and the sphere of its activities was extended to Nanking and Hupeh. All directions continued to be issued from Shanghai. Yang Siao-ming, using the alias of Zee Chun, drew up a plan and gave his assassination organization the name of "Chinese Youths' Anti-Japanese Traitors' Extermination Special Affairs Corps" with a view to inducing followers and covering up its real purposes. As Standing Committee member of the People's Movement Committee, Liu Loo-ying approved the plan and made the following written remarks: "A sum of $2,000 has been ear-marked as monthly allowance to be remitted by Zu Wen( 祖文 )" (vide evidence No. 1). Following this Yang Siao-ming gathered together Siao Tseng ( 蕭準 ) (alias Siao Rei-wei 蕭佩偉 ), Vai Gee-su ( 樊其素 ), Liang Chiu-pao ( 梁九寶 ) (these three persons are at large), and the accused Yang Gee-sing ( 楊其銓 cousin of Yang Siao-ming), and Chun Pah-chow ( 秦柏舟 nephew of Yang Siao-ming, alias Chun Pah-sung 秦伯 ), Chun Shao-sien 秦紹先 and Lung Ting 龍鼎 ), to carry out the plan approved by Liu Loo-ying. Yang Siao-ming also ordered Li Chuen-chien ( 李全堅 ), a member of the Corps, to undertake delivery of messages.

In May of the same year, Yang Gee-sing and Chun Pah-chow, on the instructions of Siao Tseng, proceeded to Lushan to investigate the movements of General Chiang Kai-shek. They found that the place known as Kwan Ying Jao ( 觀音橋 ) was lonely and suitable for an attack. The result of this investigation was reported to Siao Tseng by Yang Gee-sing (Vide statements of Yang Gee-sing and Chun Pao-chow).

1937年5月10日。上午译文

《新闻导报》（Sin Wan Dao，原文如此，应为《新闻报》）及其他本地报纸：-

指控中执委委员刘履瀛

就前湖北省政府主席杨永泰将军遇害一案，武昌地方法院首席检察官对国民党中央执行委员会委员刘隐（Liu Loo-ying，括号内中文名与拼音不符，依原文保留）提出以下指控：-

案情事实

被告刘履瀛当选为国民党中央宣传部部长，但未就职。去年西南成立民众运动委员会时，刘履瀛当选为常务委员。刘履瀛等人嫉妒前湖北省政府主席杨永泰将军、前外交部长张群（Chang Chun，音译，通常指张群）将军、内政部长蒋作宾（Chiang Tso-pin，音译）将军、交通部长俞飞鹏（Yu Fei-pang，音译）先生以及军事委员会委员长蒋介石将军，遂唆使其下属杨筱明（Yang Siao-ming）（别名徐群 Zee Chun、杨尔建 Yang Er-chien、杨又生 Yang Yeu-sung、杨伯光 Yang Pah-kwang、杨其贞 Yang Chi-cheng 及徐超 Zee Chao）在上海组建一个暗杀组织。由于在上海缺乏机会，该组织扩大规模，活动范围延伸至南京和湖北。所有指令继续从上海发出。杨筱明使用徐群（Zee Chun）的别名，制定计划，并将其暗杀组织命名为“中国青年反汉奸特别事务队”，以诱骗追随者并掩盖其真实目的。作为民众运动委员会常务委员，刘履瀛批准了该计划，并写下如下批示：“每月津贴2,000元，由祖文（Zu Wen）汇寄”（见证据第1号）。随后，杨筱明召集萧準（Siao Tseng，别名萧佩伟 Siao Rei-wei）、樊其素（Vai Gee-su）、梁九寶（Liang Chiu-pao）（此三人在逃），以及被告杨其銓（Yang Gee-sing，杨筱明的堂兄弟）和秦柏舟（Chun Pah-chow，杨筱明的侄子，别名秦伯 Chun Pah-sung）、秦紹先（Chun Shao-sien）和龍鼎（Lung Ting），执行经刘履瀛批准的计划。杨筱明还命令该队队员李全堅（Li Chuen-chien）负责传递消息。

同年5月，杨其銓和秦柏舟奉萧準之命前往庐山调查蒋介石将军的行踪。他们发现名为观音桥（Kwan Ying Jao）的地方偏僻且适合袭击。杨其銓将调查结果报告给萧準（见杨其銓和秦柏舟的供词，原文 Pao-chow 应为 Pah-chow）。

No. D

4
May 10, 1937. Morning Translation

In August, Yang Siao-ming called Yang Gee-sing and Chun Pah-chow to Shanghai by letter and personally told them to go to Nanking to investigate the movements of General Chang Chun. He also gave Chun Pah-chow $70 and told him to buy a pistol and then go from Nanking to Hankow to assassinate General Yang Yung-tai. On arrival at Nanking Yang Gee-sing made one investigation in company with Chun Pah-chow and two investigations alone, as a result of which he held the Chinese Overseas Reception Office to be the most suitable place and accordingly wrote to Yang Siao-ming so that preparation for the assassination could be made. Chun Pah-chow bought a pistol in Nanking and brought it to Hankow. It was then September and Yang Siao-ming was already in Hankow before Chun arrived. Yang Siao-ming used the alias "Zee Chao". He and Siao Tseng, Vai Gee-su, Liang Chiu-pao and Zao Ping-yong (曹炳榮) concealed themselves in House No. 39 on San Chiao Street (三教街) and in the Hsin Tai An Lodging House. Just at that time Cheng Sih-chao (成世超 alias Tan Wen-sing 譚文信, Tan Zcong-hsi 譚戎軒 and Cheng Tah 成達), a friend of Vai Gee-su, was also in Hankow and met Vai. Knowing that Cheng Sih-chao was of a violent character, Vai induced him to join the assassination organization as an active assassin. A pistol which was secretly bought in July was handed to Cheng Sih-chao. Yang Siao-ming took charge of all affairs and showed the photograph of General Yang Yung-tai to the assassins so that they might recognize him. At first Liang Chiu-pao was detailed to wait at the San Tao Street (三道街) in Wuchang where General Yang Yung-tai was bound to pass when he went out, and to try to obstruct traffic when General Yang was passing so that Cheng Sih-chao and Chun Pah-chow might be able to shoot. The plan was twice not carried out owing to hesitation on the part of the persons detailed. They later waited on the street near the Provincial Government, but again could not carry out their plan owing to the heavy guard there. It was then decided to execute their plan at a jetty in Hankow.

In the morning of October 25, Yang Siao-ming and Zao Ping-yong came to Wuchang and learned that General Yang Yung-tai was going to a banquet to be given at Hankow and would stay there for two or three hours. They followed General Yang and on arriving at the Hankow side of the river, Yang Siao-ming told Zao Ping-yong to stand at the People's Enquiry Office to mark the spot, while Yang himself returned to the Hsin Tai An Lodging House and ordered Cheng Sih-chao and Chun Pah-chow to go to the jetty, each carrying a loaded pistol, and wait there. Yang Siao-ming went secretly to the jetty to supervise the others and give directions. At 3 o'clock, General Yang Yung-tai arrived in a car. Before General Yang had walked far after alighting from his car, Cheng Sih-chao stole up from behind and shot him twice in the back, both shots inflicting mortal wounds. General Yang died from the wounds soon afterwards. Cheng Sih-chao was arrested on the spot, while Liu Loc-ying, Chun Pah-chow, Zao Ping-yong, Yang Gee-sing and Li Chuen-chien were later separately arrested at Wuhu, Nanking and Shanghai. This Court was then ordered by the Hupeh High Court to enquire into the case.

1937年5月10日。上午译文

8月，杨筱明写信召杨其銓和秦柏舟到上海，并亲自告诉他们去南京调查张群（Chang Chun）将军的行踪。他还给了秦柏舟70元，让他购买手枪，然后从南京去汉口刺杀杨永泰将军。抵达南京后，杨其銓与秦柏舟共同进行了一次调查，并单独进行了两次调查，结果认为华侨招待所是最合适的地点，于是写信给杨筱明，以便为暗杀做准备。秦柏舟在南京购买了手枪并带到汉口。当时已是9月，杨筱明在秦到达之前已身在汉口。杨筱明使用“徐超”（Zee Chao）的别名。他与萧準、樊其素、梁九寶和曹炳榮（Zao Ping-yong）藏身于三教街39号和新泰安旅馆。就在那时，樊其素的朋友成世超（Cheng Sih-chao，别名谭文信 Tan Wen-sing、谭戎轩 Tan Zcong-hsi [原文不清] 和成达 Cheng Tah）也在汉口并与樊会面。樊知道成世超性格暴烈，便引诱他加入暗杀组织担任主动刺客。一把于7月秘密购买的手枪被交给成世超。杨筱明主持一切事务，并向刺客们出示杨永泰将军的照片，以便他们辨认。起初，梁九寶被派往武昌三道街等候，因为杨永泰将军外出时必经此地，并试图在杨将军经过时阻碍交通，以便成世超和秦柏舟能够开枪。由于被指派人员犹豫不决，该计划两次未能实施。后来他们在省政府附近的街道上守候，但因那里警卫森严，再次无法实施计划。于是决定在汉口的一个码头执行计划。

10月25日上午，杨筱明和曹炳榮来到武昌，得知杨永泰将军将前往汉口参加宴会，并将在那里停留两三个小时。他们尾随杨将军，到达江对岸的汉口一侧时，杨筱明让曹炳榮站在人民问事处标记地点，而他自己则返回新泰安旅馆，命令成世超和秦柏舟各携带一支装好子弹的手枪前往码头等候。杨筱明秘密前往码头监督其他人并给予指示。3点钟，杨永泰将军乘车抵达。杨将军下车后没走多远，成世超从背后悄悄靠近，向他背部开了两枪，两枪均造成致命伤。杨将军不久后因伤去世。成世超当场被捕，而刘履瀛（Liu Loc-ying，原文拼写错误）、秦柏舟、曹炳榮、杨其銓和李全堅后来分别在芜湖、南京和上海被捕。随后，湖北高等法院命令本院调查此案。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY.

No. D
/ /

May 10, 1937.
Morning Translation

Evidence and Charges

The evidence obtained by the Procurator during
preliminary investigation is sufficient to show that the
accused Liu Loo-ying is suspected of having committed an
offence and in accordance with Section 1, Article 230 of the
Code of Criminal Procedure, a public prosecution is instituted.
The penmanship of the plan for the formation of the
"Chinese Youths' Anti-Japanese Traitors' Extermination Special
Affairs Corps", which was drawn up by Zee Chun, is found to be
the work of Yang Siso-ming which fact was corroborated by
Yang Gee-sing (vide the record of investigation of March 23).
The remark appearing on the back of this plan, viz. "A sum
of $2,000 has been earmarked as the monthly allowance to be
remitted by Zu Wen" was written by Liu Loo-ying, who has made
a confession to this effect.
After the plan was approved, Yang Siao-ming, under
the cover of anti-Japanese and traitors' extermination work,
undertook to intensify the assassination organization and
posted his agents at Nanking, Hankow, etc. to carry out
surreptitiously the assassination work. For instance,
in May last year he instructed Siao Tseng to write to Yang
Gee-sing and Chun Peh-chow asking the latter to proceed to
Lushan to investigate the movements of General Chiang Kai-
shek. In August, he wrote a letter asking Yang Gee-sing
and Chun Pah-chow to come to Shanghai to give them verbal
instructions and also instructed Yang Gee-sing to act as a
communication agent to investigate the movements of General
Chang Chun, former Minister of Foreign Affairs, in Nanking
and to select a place to perpetrate the crime. He gave
Chun Pah-chow $70 to purchase a pistol and told him to
proceed to Hankow to commit a murder. He himself arrived
at Hankow before Chun Pah-chow and supervised the work under
the assumed name of Zee Chao. On October 25 last year he
was present on the wharf in front of the Hankow Custom House
and directed Cheng Sih-chao and Chun Pah-chow in the fatal
shooting of General Yang Yung-tai, late Chairman of the Hupeh
Provincial Government.
Separate statements made by accomplices Yang Gee-
sing, Chun Psh-chow, Cheng Sih-chao and Zao Ping-yong all
point to this conclusion. From the evidence gathered, it
shows that the steps taken by Yang Siao-ming in carrying out
the murder and in the posting of agents in Nanking and Hankow
all correspond to the plan of Liu Loo-ying. It is an
established fact that Liu Loo-ying has instigated Yang Siso-
ming to organize an assassination organization to commit
murder. Liu Loo-ying, however, argued saying: "It was
prior to the revolt of Liang-Kwang authorities that I was
appointed a member of the Standing Committee of the People's
Movement Committee and that I put the remarks on the plan.
At that time I was forced by circumstances and wrote the
remarks according to verbal instructions of others. I had
absolutely no idea of the contents of the plan. I was
also not in charge of the funds. I had long resigned
my post as a member of the People's Movement Committee
and I have actually no knowledge of the present case."

1937年5月10日。
晨间译件

证据与指控

检察官在初步调查中获得的证据足以表明，被告刘鲁英涉嫌犯罪，根据《刑事诉讼法》第二百三十条第一款之规定，提起公诉。
经查，“中国青年抗日除奸特别事务队”组建计划书由Zee Chun起草，其笔迹确认为杨思敏（Yang Siso-ming）所写，此事实已由杨吉星（Yang Gee-sing）证实（参见三月二十三日调查记录）。
该计划书背面注有“每月津贴贰仟元，由祖文汇寄”字样，系刘鲁英所写，刘鲁英已对此供认不讳。
计划书获批后，杨思敏以抗日除奸工作为掩护，着手强化暗杀组织，并在南京、汉口等地部署特工，秘密执行暗杀任务。例如，去年五月，他指示萧增致信杨吉星和周伯舟，要求后者前往庐山调查蒋介石将军的行踪。八月，他写信让杨吉星和周伯舟来沪，当面给予指示，并指令杨吉星担任联络特工，调查前外交部长张群将军在南京的行踪，并选定作案地点。他给周伯舟七十元购买手枪，并命其前往汉口实施谋杀。他本人化名Zee Chao，先于周伯舟抵达汉口，督导行动。去年十月二十五日，他在汉口海关前的码头现场，指挥郑思超和周伯舟枪杀了前任湖北省政府主席杨永泰将军。
从犯杨吉星、周伯舟、郑思超和赵平勇分别作出的供述均指向这一结论。收集到的证据显示，杨思敏实施谋杀及在南京、汉口部署特工的步骤，均与刘鲁英的计划相符。刘鲁英唆使杨思敏组织暗杀团体实施谋杀，此为既定事实。然而，刘鲁英辩称：“在两广当局反叛之前，我被任命为人民运动委员会常务委员，并在计划书上作了批注。当时我受形势所迫，按照他人的口头指示写下批注。我对计划书的内容完全不知情。我也不负责资金管理。我早已辞去人民运动委员会委员之职，对本案实际上毫不知情。”

May 10, 1937.
6
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
Morning Translation S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D

The plan approved by Yang Siao-ming contains
the following: "(2) Expenditure on activities refers to /
those in abnormal times. (3) Reserve funds during abnormal
times are not to be included in the activities' expenditure.
A certain sum of the reserve funds must be laid aside as
a preparation for travelling expenses when it becomes
necessary to abscond". The title of their organization
includes the words "To Exterminate Traitors" and everybody
may know at a glance at the title of the organization that
it is an assassination body. Liu Loo-ying states that
this organization forms part of the schemes made by the
People's Movement Committee. Liu was directing the
affairs of the Committee and furthermore it was he who
approved the expenses for the special service corps.
There is no reason to believe that he had no knowledge
of all this. On Page 16 of the statement personally
written by Siao Cho-hsu (萧木生), there are accounts
concerning Liu Loo-ying's directing of the work of
assassination. The statement of Siao may be adopted and
believed, for they were closely connected. Despite the
fact that accomplices Yang Gee-sing and Chun Peh-chow
have made some remarks regarding the instigators of this
case, yet it will be difficult for Liu Loo-ying to explain
that he was not responsible for joint instigations in the
case. From all their actions, they have committed
offences under Article 28, the latter paragraph of Section 1
of Article 154, Sections 1 and 2 of Article 29 and Sections 1
and 3 of Article 271 of the Criminal Code and should be
dealt with according to Article 55 of the same Code for
joint instigations of assassination.

DEATH ANNIVERSARY OF MR. HU HAN-MIN TO BE
COMMEMORATED TO-DAY

The Shanghai Special District Kuomintang
Headquarters publishes the following notice in the
advertisement columns of the "Sin Wan Pao", the "Shun Pao"
and other local newspapers :-
May 12 will be the first anniversary of the
death of Mr. Hu Han-min. As it happens that the
Coronation ceremony of the King of England will also take
place on that day, the meeting to commemorate the death
anniversary of Mr. Hu will be held at 10 a.m. May 10 at
the auditorium of the Headquarters. All local organizations,
public bodies, schools and various Tangpu branches are
hereby notified to send representatives to participate
in the commemoration meeting. The national flag will
be hoisted at half-mast during the day.

杨思敏批准的计划书中包含以下内容：“(2) 活动经费指非常时期之开支。(3) 非常时期的储备金不计入活动经费。必须从储备金中留出一部分款项，作为必要时潜逃的旅费准备”。该组织名称中包含“除奸”二字，任何人一眼便知这是一个暗杀团体。刘鲁英声称该组织是人民运动委员会方案的一部分。刘鲁英主管该委员会事务，此外，特别服务队的经费也是由他批准的。没有理由相信他对这一切毫不知情。在萧木生（Siao Cho-hsu）亲笔陈述书的第十六页上，有关于刘鲁英指挥暗杀工作的记载。鉴于二人关系密切，萧的陈述可以被采信。尽管从犯杨吉星和周伯舟就本案的唆使者发表了一些言论，但刘鲁英很难解释自己不对本案的共同唆使行为负责。从他们的所有行动来看，他们触犯了《刑法》第二十八条、第一百五十四条第一款后半段、第二十九条第一及第二款以及第二百七十一条第一及第三款之规定，并应根据同法第五十五条关于共同唆使谋杀的规定予以惩处。

胡汉民先生逝世周年纪念日将于今日举行纪念活动

国民党上海特别市党部在《新闻报》、《申报》及其他本地报纸的广告栏刊登如下通告：
5月12日是胡汉民先生逝世一周年纪念日。适逢当日亦为英国国王加冕典礼之日，故胡先生逝世周年纪念大会定于5月10日上午10时在党部礼堂举行。特此通知各地方组织、公共团体、学校及各区分部派代表参加纪念大会。当日国旗将下半旗志哀。

THE LIEU JU YING CASE

The preliminary hearing of the case will be held by the District Court.

THE CASE OF LIEU LOO YING

Upon arrival at Wuchang under escort, Lieu Loo Ying, a member of the Central Executive Committee of the Kuomintang who was arrested in Shanghai for being concerned in the murder of General Yang Yung Tai, former Chairman of the Hupeh Provincial Government, was handed over to the First Gaol for detention by order of the Procurator of the Hupeh High Court. Social Daily News (社會日報) publishes the following article written by Li Ah Mou (李阿毛):-
THE THREE FEARS OF JAPAN

Japan is afraid of three things: (1) co-operation between Great Britain and the U.S.A., (2) the strengthening of Soviet Russia and (3) the unification of China.
These things have now all come to pass, and, ironically enough, all this was due to Japan herself. If Japan had not tried so hard to expand her influence in the Far East, Great Britain and the U.S.A. would never have found it necessary to co-operate with each other; if Japan had not directed her unwanted attention to Siberia, Soviet Russia would have devoted her whole energy to her Five-Year Plan and would not have increased her armaments in the Far East; if the September 18 Incident had not happened, the Chinese warlords would still be fighting one another to-day.

《社会日报》刊登李阿毛撰写的以下文章：
日本的三大恐惧

日本害怕三件事：(1) 英美合作，(2) 苏联的强大，以及 (3) 中国的统一。
这些情况如今均已发生，具有讽刺意味的是，这一切皆归咎于日本自身。如果日本没有如此努力地在远东扩张其影响力，英美两国绝不会觉得有必要相互合作；如果日本没有将其不必要的注意力指向西伯利亚，苏联本会将全部精力投入其五年计划，而不会在远东增加军备；如果没有九一八事变，中国的军阀们今天仍会互相混战。

Afternoon Translation.

Ta Mei Wan Pao dated Mar.2 (letter from Hankow):

THE CASE OF LIEU LOO YING

The following particulars have been obtained regarding the murder of General Yang Yung Tai, former Chairman of the Hupeh Provincial Government, in connection with which Lieu Loo Ying, a member of the Central Executive Committee of the Kuomintang, was recently arrested in Shanghai:-

In order to keep an appointment with the American Consul, General Yang Yung Tai came to Hankow last year on the day of the State funeral of the late Mr. Hu Han Min, former Chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the Kuomintang. After the appointment, the General returned in company with his wife. Whilst alighting from his car, General Yang was shot at. He died at the Dong Jen Hospital. The assassin Zung Sih Chao (成榮望) was arrested on the spot by a post duty policeman. Subsequently Koo Ih Vai (顧一凡), Loo Zing Ning (羅靜甯) and Wen Mow Kung (文茂宮), three ringleaders in the plot, were apprehended.

Chuin Pah Chuan (葉柏舟), Siao Shah Shui (蕭若虛) and other accomplices of the arrested men arrested at Nanking and Shanghai were escorted to Hankow on February 8.

It is understood that amongst the arrested persons are two university professors and one senior officer of a certain official organ. It is said that important evidence against one Lieu Loo Ying has been secured at Hongkong.

Lieu Loo Ying, native of Yung Feng Hsien (永豐縣), Kiangsi, B.A. of California University, was at one time Chief Secretary to the Chinese Kuomintang Branch Headquarters, editor of a newspaper known as "Young China" in America, and professor of Futan University, Chung San University and Chi Chi University; he is also member of the C.E.C. of the Kuomintang, member of the Examination Committee and Chief of the Central Propaganda Department. He was much respected by the late Mr. Hu Han Min.

At the beginning of the Kwangtung-Kwangsi trouble last year, Lieu Loo Ying went to Kwangsi from Hongkong and then to Nanking after the trouble had been peacefully settled. Not long afterwards, he returned to Hongkong. It was subsequently reported that he had formed the so-called "Chinese Youths Special Affairs Corps of the Revolutionary Army Group", a secret organization, and that he was in league with Wong Yis Chiao (王益樵), of the Axe Party. He engaged agents and despatched them to Nanking, Shanghai, Peiping and other places to undertake the assassination of high government officials. After his successful plot to murder Mr. Tang Yu Jen, the former Vice Minister of Foreign Affairs, Lieu Loo Ying became very active.

The real name of the man Zung Sih Chao who assassinated General Yang Yung Tai is Tan Wen Hsin (文信). He was at one time a junior military officer. Chuin Pah Chuan is also one of the ringleaders. Following the murder of General Yang, Chuin Pah Chuan secretly escaped to Shanghai but was eventually apprehended at Wuhu.

Mr. Lieu Shou Bang (劉守邦), Chief of the Field Headquarters Military Court, is reported to have left for Nanking to make a report to his superiors on the Court proceedings in this case and to ask for instructions. The affair will probably be transferred to the Nanking Supreme Court.

《大美晚报》3月2日讯（汉口来信）：

刘庐英案

关于前湖北省政府主席杨永泰将军被杀一案，国民党中执委委员刘庐英近期在上海被捕，现将已获悉的详情列述如下：

为履行与美国领事的约会，杨永泰将军于去年前国民党中央常务委员会主席胡汉民先生举行国葬之日抵达汉口。约会结束后，将军与其夫人一同返回。在下汽车时，杨将军遭枪击。他在同仁医院身亡。刺客成荣望（Zung Sih Chao）当场被一名执勤警察逮捕。随后，阴谋主犯顾一凡（Koo Ih Vai）、罗静宁（Loo Zing Ning）和文茂宫（Wen Mow Kung）三人也被捕。

2月8日，叶柏舟（Chuin Pah Chuan）、萧若虚（Siao Shah Shui）及其他在南京和上海被捕的同伙被押解至汉口。

据悉，被捕者中有两名大学教授和某官方机构的一名高级官员。据说在香港已获取针对刘庐英的重要证据。

刘庐英，江西永丰县人，加州大学文学士，曾任中国国民党分部总部总秘书、美国《少年中国》报编辑，以及复旦、中山、齐鲁大学教授；他亦是国民党中央执行委员会委员、考选委员会委员及中央宣传部部长。他深受已故胡汉民先生敬重。

在去年两广事变初期，刘庐英从香港前往广西，事变和平解决后前往南京。不久后，他返回香港。随后有报道称，他组建了名为“革命军集团中国青年特种事务队”的秘密组织，并与斧头党成员王益樵（Wong Yis Chiao）勾结。他招募特工并将其派往南京、上海、北平等地，从事刺杀政府高官的活动。在成功策划刺杀前外交部次长唐有壬先生后，刘庐英变得非常活跃。

刺杀杨永泰将军的凶手成荣望，真名为文信（Tan Wen Hsin）。他曾是一名低级军官。叶柏舟也是主犯之一。杨将军遇刺后，叶柏舟秘密逃往上海，但最终在芜湖被捕。

据报，野战司令部军法处处长刘守邦（Lieu Shou Bang）先生已前往南京，就本案法庭审理情况向上级汇报并请示指示。此案可能会移交南京最高法院审理。

March 2, 1937. Morning Translation

Shun Pao and other local newspapers :-

C.E.C. MEMBER TO BE EXTRADITED TO HUPEH

Mr. Lieu Loo Ying, a member of the Central Executive Committee of the Kuomintang, who was arrested at 1.30 a.m. February 24 in connection with the murder of General Yang Yung Tai, former Chairman of the Hupeh Provincial Government, and Mr. Tang Yu Jen, former Vice Minister of Foreign Affairs, was charged on remand before Judge Feng Shih Teh (士傑) at the Shanghai First Special District Court at 10.50 a.m. yesterday.

Mr. Lieu was defended by lawyers Wong Ziu An (王舟安), Zoen Yoch Hwa (榮毓華) and Ho Shiao Nyoen(何孝元), while the Shanghai City Government Police Bureau was represented by its legal adviser, Mr. Tsang Chi Voong(張記風).

Mr. Paul Y. Ru, Assistant Municipal Advocate, informed the Court that an official from the Hupeh High Court was due in Shanghai at about 11 a.m. and requested the Court to adjourn the hearing until 2 p.m.

Lawyer Tsang Chi Voong of the Police Bureau said: "The Court and the Police Bureau have received despatches from the Hupeh High Court. As everything is in proper order, I request that the case be heard immediately."

Lawyer Tsang then produced the despatch to the Court.

Judge Feng stated that the Court had received a telegram from Mr. Zung Sze Tseng(曾錚聲), Chief Procurator of the Hupeh High Court; he also understood that the Shanghai City Government had also received a telegram.

At the request of Mr. Lieu and his lawyers, the document was read out. Briefly it stated that Mr. Lieu was concerned in the murder of General Yang Yung Tai and that in view of the gravity of the case his extradition was requested.

At this juncture, Mr. Tsang Foh Sung(張福松), an official from the Hupeh High Court, arrived with the document.

Judge Feng said: "If an accused is arrested by authorities other than a judicial organ, it is necessary for this Court to examine the evidence against him before granting his extradition. As the Hupeh High Court is a competent judicial organ, its request for Mr. Lieu's extradition is granted."

Mr. Lieu's lawyers requested the Court to allow Mr. Lieu to be released on security before granting his extradition.

Mr. Lieu then requested the Court to conduct a careful investigation into his case and to release him on security before granting the extradition. Mr. Lieu further stated that if the Court refused to grant his release on bail, he would engage lawyers to file a protest.

Judge Feng stated that the Court could not refuse the request for Mr. Lieu's extradition and that a protest would not stay the procedure. He then ruled that Mr. Lieu Loo Ying be handed over to the official from the Hupeh High Court and that the Shanghai City Government Police Bureau provide an escort.

1937年3月2日。上午译件

《申报》及本地其他报纸：

中执委委员将被引渡至湖北

国民党中执委委员刘庐英先生因涉嫌参与谋杀前湖北省政府主席杨永泰将军及前外交部次长唐有壬先生，于2月24日凌晨1时30分被捕，昨日上午10时50分在上海第一特区地方法院冯士傑法官面前受审候讯。

刘先生由律师王舟安（Wong Ziu An）、榮毓華（Zoen Yoch Hwa）和何孝元（Ho Shiao Nyoen）辩护，上海市政府警察局由其法律顾问张记风（Tsang Chi Voong）先生代表出庭。

助理市检察官鲁保罗（Paul Y. Ru）先生告知法庭，湖北高等法院的一名官员预计于上午11点左右抵达上海，并请求法庭将听证会推迟至下午2点。

警察局律师张记风说：“法庭和警察局已收到湖北高等法院的公文。由于一切手续完备，我请求立即审理此案。”

随后，张律师向法庭出示了该公文。

冯法官表示，法庭已收到湖北高等法院首席检察官曾錚聲（Zung Sze Tseng）先生的电报；他也获悉上海市政府也收到了电报。

应刘先生及其律师的要求，宣读了该文件。其大意是刘先生涉及杨永泰将军被杀案，鉴于案情重大，请求将其引渡。

此时，湖北高等法院官员张福松（Tsang Foh Sung）先生携带文件到达。

冯法官说：“如果被告被非司法机关的当局逮捕，本庭在批准引渡前必须审查对其不利的证据。由于湖北高等法院是有管辖权的司法机关，其引渡刘先生的请求予以批准。”

刘先生的律师请求法庭在批准引渡前允许刘先生具保释放。

刘先生随后请求法庭对其案件进行仔细调查，并在批准引渡前允许其具保释放。刘先生进一步表示，如果法庭拒绝批准其保释，他将聘请律师提出抗议。

冯法官表示，法庭不能拒绝引渡刘先生的请求，且抗议不会中止程序。随后他裁定将刘庐英先生移交给湖北高等法院官员，并由上海市政府警察局提供护送。

March 2, 1937.
Morning Translation

Here the Court rose. Mr. Lieu was taken
back to Chengtu Road Police Station where, after the
necessary formalities, he was removed to the Shanghai City
Government Police Bureau at noon.
The following is the document from the Hupeh
High Court requesting Mr. Lieu's extradition :-
"It has been confessed by Zung Sih Chao
(成璧超), Chun Pah Chow(柏舟) and other prisoners
arrested for the murder of General Yang Yung Tai, former
Chairman of the Hupeh Provincial Government, that the murder
was planned by Lieu Loo Ying. This man has also organized
two reactionary bodies known as the 'Revolutionary Army
Group' and the 'Chinese Youth Special Affairs Corps' with
agents scattered throughout the country to undertake
assassinations. His extradition to this tribunal is
therefore requested."

至此法庭休庭。刘先生被带回成都路捕房，在办理必要手续后，于中午被移送至上海市政府警察局。
以下是湖北高等法院请求引渡刘先生的文件：
“因谋杀前湖北省政府主席杨永泰将军而被捕的囚犯成璧超（Zung Sih Chao）、柏舟（Chun Pah Chow）等人已供认，谋杀系由刘庐英策划。此人还组织了两个反动团体，即‘革命军集团’和‘中国青年特种事务队’，特工遍布全国，从事刺杀活动。因此请求将其引渡至本庭。”

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. M. REGISTRY.
No. D 7809/4
Date 2 / 1 / 37
March 2, 1937. Morning Translation

Shun Pao and other local newspapers :-

C.E.C. MEMBER TO BE EXTRADITED TO HUPEH

Mr. Lieu Loo Ying, a member of the Central Executive Committee of the Kuomintang, who was arrested at 1.30 a.m. February 24 in connection with the murder of General Yang Yung Tai, former Chairman of the Hupeh Provincial Government, and Mr. Tang Yu Jen, former Vice Minister of Foreign Affairs, was charged on remand before Judge Feng Shih Teh (馮士傑) at the Shanghai First Special District Court at 10.50 a.m. yesterday.

Mr. Lieu was defended by lawyers Wong Ziu An (王舟安), Zoen Yoeh Hwa (周悅華) and Ho Shiao Nyoen(何孝元), while the Shanghai City Government Police Bureau was represented by its legal adviser, Mr. Tsang Chi Voong(張記風).

Mr. Paul Y. Ru, Assistant Municipal Advocate, informed the Court that an official from the Hupeh High Court was due in Shanghai at about 11 a.m. and requested the Court to adjourn the hearing until 2 p.m.

Lawyer Tsang Chi Voong of the Police Bureau said: "The Court and the Police Bureau have received despatches from the Hupeh High Court. As everything is in proper order, I request that the case be heard immediately."

Lawyer Tsang then produced the despatch to the Court.

Judge Feng stated that the Court had received a telegram from Mr. Zung Sze Tseng(曾師曾), Chief Procurator of the Hupeh High Court; he also understood that the Shanghai City Government had also received a telegram.

At the request of Mr. Lieu and his lawyers, the document was read out. Briefly it stated that Mr. Lieu was concerned in the murder of General Yang Yung Tai and that in view of the gravity of the case his extradition was requested.

At this juncture, Mr. Tsang Foh Sung(張福新), an official from the Hupeh High Court, arrived with the document.

Judge Feng said: "If an accused is arrested by authorities other than a judicial organ, it is necessary for this Court to examine the evidence against him before granting his extradition. As the Hupeh High Court is a competent judicial organ, its request for Mr. Lieu's extradition is granted."

Mr. Lieu's lawyers requested the Court to allow Mr. Lieu to be released on security before granting his extradition.

Mr. Lieu then requested the Court to conduct a careful investigation into his case and to release him on security before granting the extradition. Mr. Lieu further stated that if the Court refused to grant his release on bail, he would engage lawyers to file a protest.

Judge Feng stated that the Court could not refuse the request for Mr. Lieu's extradition and that a protest would not stay the procedure. He then ruled that Mr. Lieu Loo Ying be handed over to the official from the Hupeh High Court and that the Shanghai City Government Police Bureau provide an escort.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. M. REGISTRY.
No. D 2809
Date 1 3 37

February 27, 1937. Morning Translation.

Ta Kung Pao and other local newspapers:-

THE ARREST OF MR. LIEU LOO YING

Mr. Lieu Loo Ying, a member of the C.E.C. of
the Kuomintang, was arrested on February 24 at the
Yangtsze Hotel in connection with the murder of General
Yang Yung Tai, former Chairman of the Hupeh Provincial
Government, and Mr. Tang Yu Jen, ex-vice Minister of
Foreign Affairs. He is now being detained at Chengtu
Road Police Station and is favourably treated. His
meals are sent to him by his family and his wife visits
him occasionally. Persons who desire to see him must
first get permission from the Police Station and the
approval of Mr. Lieu himself. So far, he has received
only one or two visitors.

His case will be resumed on the morning of
March 1 when an application for his extradition will
be made by the Chinese authorities.

1937年2月27日。晨间译件。

《大公报》及其他本地报纸：

刘芦英先生被捕

国民党中央执行委员会委员刘芦英先生，因涉嫌参与谋杀前湖北省政府主席杨永泰将军及前外交部次长唐有壬先生，于2月24日在扬子饭店被捕。他目前被拘押在成都路巡捕房，受到优待。他的饭菜由家人送来，其妻偶尔前来探视。欲会见者须先获得巡捕房许可，并经刘先生本人同意。迄今为止，他仅接待过一两名访客。

他的案件将于3月1日上午重新审理，届时中国当局将提出引渡申请。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 7809
26.1.37

February 26, 1937.

MAINICHI

THE RESIGNATION OF DEPUTY COMMISSIONER
TAJIMA

At 4 p.m. February 26 the
Standing Committee of the Japanese Amalgamated Association
of Street Unions will hold a meeting at the Japanese
Club to consider the resignation of Deputy Commissioner
Tajima of the S.M.P.

RECONSTRUCTION OF TOYODA COTTON MILL CASE

The Toyoda Cotton Mill
strike, which was caused by the stabbing of one Sun Yen
Tai, representative of the Toyoda Cotton Mill workers,
resulted in an attack on the Zaokadoo Police Station
and injury to the officer in charge. The trouble was
eventually settled by the General Labour Union.
On February 23 the Shanghai
District Court Procurator's Office dispatched several
officers to the Zaokadoo Police Station to conduct a
reconstruction of the attack. The Third Department of
the City Government Police Bureau took a statement from
the officer in charge of the Zaokadoo Police Station.
This statement was forwarded to the Procurator's Office.

THE ARREST OF MR. LIEU LOO YIN

Mr. Lieu Loo Yin, a member of
the Central Executive Committee of the Kuomintang, was
arrested in front of the Yangchow Hotel in the International
Settlement by detectives of the Woosung-Shanghai Defence
Commissioner's Headquarters on suspicion that he was
concerned in the assassination of General Yang Young Tai
and Mr. Tang Yu Jen, Vice Minister of Foreign Affairs.
The Chinese authorities should
follow the proper procedure when they desire the arrest
of an important political suspect in the International
Settlement. In the case of the arrest of Mr. Lieu Loo
Yin they have failed to observe this procedure. Their
action is likely to give rise to a serious question
between the Chinese authorities and the S.M.C. The
S.M.P. will not lodge a protest, but the Municipal Council
should take up the matter and lodge a protest.

The Mainichi publishes the
following leading article:-
After the close of the Third
Plenary Session, the Central Standing Committee discharged
Mr. Lieu Loo Yin from the Central Propaganda Department
while the Executive Yuan dismissed Mr. Lieu Ki Vung, who
belongs to the same clique as Mr. Lieu Loo Yin, from
the Kwangtung Provincial Government, and appointed General
Li Tsung Jen and General Pah Seeng Hai as Commander-in-Chief
and Vice Commander-in-Chief respectively of the Fifth
Route Army. Mr. Lieu Loo Yin was arrested in Shanghai
on February 24. General Li and General Pah will dissolve
the Independent Fourth Army and on March 1 will take up
their new positions with the Central Government.

编号 D 7809
26.1.37

1937年2月26日。

《每日新闻》

田岛副总监辞职

2月26日下午4时，日本街道工会联合会常务委员会将在日本俱乐部举行会议，审议工部局警务处田岛副总监的辞职事宜。

丰田纱厂案件重现

丰田纱厂罢工是由该厂工人代表孙燕泰（Sun Yen Tai，音译）被刺引发的，导致对曹家渡巡捕房的袭击以及当值警官受伤。此次风波最终由总工会平息。
2月23日，上海地方法院检察署派遣数名官员前往曹家渡巡捕房，进行袭击事件的重现演练。市政府警察局第三科对曹家渡巡捕房负责警官进行了问话笔录。该笔录已转送检察署。

刘芦英先生被捕

国民党中央执行委员会委员刘芦英先生，因涉嫌参与刺杀杨永泰将军及外交部次长唐有壬先生，在公共租界扬州饭店门前被淞沪警备司令部侦探逮捕。
中国当局若要在公共租界逮捕重要政治嫌疑犯，应遵循正当程序。在逮捕刘芦英先生一案中，他们未能遵守此程序。此举很可能在中国当局与工部局之间引发严重问题。工部局警务处不会提出抗议，但工部局董事会应介入此事并提出抗议。

《每日新闻》发表以下社论：
三中全会闭幕后，中央常务委员会免去了刘芦英先生在中央宣传部的职务，同时行政院罢免了与刘芦英同属一派的刘纪文（Lieu Ki Vung，音译）在广东省政府的职务，并任命李宗仁将军和白崇禧将军（Pah Seeng Hai，音译）分别为第五路军总司令和副总司令。刘芦英于2月24日在上海被捕。李将军和白将军将解散独立第四军，并于3月1日赴中央政府就任新职。

pages.en:
February 26. 1937.

-2-

Political significance is
attached to the arrest of Mr. Lieu Loo Yin because of his
anti-Central Government activities as well as the
assassination of General Yang Young Tai and Mr. Tang Yu
Jen. General Li and General Pah's obedience to the
Central Government and the loyalty of Kwangsi are also
worthy of attention.
Mr. Lieu Loo Yin played an
important part in bringing about co-operation between
General Chiang Kai Shek and Mr. Hu Han Min when the
latter returned to China from abroad. After the Second
Plenary Session in July, 1936, Mr. Lieu Loo Yin was
appointed Chief of the Central Propaganda Department,
but he failed in this work. He returned to the South
and prevented Mr. Hu Han Min from coming to Nanking and
worked against the Central Government. After Mr. Hu Han
Min's death he succeeded in persuading the military leaders
in the two Kwangs to oppose the Central Government. Mr.
Lieu also attempted to bring together the popular front
and the remaining members of the revolutionary independent
government established in Fukien. He is believed to be
connected with the Sian incident. It is not certain
whether he is the principal in the assassination of
General Yang Young Tai and Mr. Tang Yu Jen, but it is
undeniable that the assassinations were planned by him.
Mr. Lieu is dangerous to the Nanking Government because
of late he was actively engaged in an attempt to establish
an independent government. For this reason, he was
arrested by the Nanking Government as a warning to other
radical elements who are opposed to Nanking.
pages.zh:
1937年2月26日。

-2-

刘芦英先生被捕具有政治意义，这不仅因为他参与了杨永泰将军和唐有壬先生的刺杀案，还因为他的反中央政府活动。李将军和白将军对中央政府的服从以及广西的忠诚也值得关注。

在胡汉民先生从海外归国时，刘芦英先生在促成蒋介石将军与胡汉民先生合作方面发挥了重要作用。1936年7月二中全会后，刘芦英先生被任命为中央宣传部部长，但他在此项工作中未能取得成功。他返回南方，阻止胡汉民先生前往南京，并从事反对中央政府的活动。胡汉民先生去世后，他成功说服两广军事领导人反对中央政府。刘先生还试图联合人民阵线以及在福建建立的革命独立政府的残余成员。据信他与西安事变有关联。虽然尚不确定他是否是刺杀杨永泰将军和唐有壬先生的主谋，但不可否认的是，这些刺杀行动是由他策划的。由于刘先生近期积极从事建立独立政府的活动，他对南京政府构成威胁。因此，南京政府逮捕了他，以警告其他反对南京的激进分子。

This statement was forwarded to the Procurator's Office.

THE ARREST OF MR. LIEU LOO YIN

Mr. Lieu Loo Yin, a member of
the Central Executive Committee of the Kuomintang, was
arrested in front of the Yangchow Hotel in the International
Settlement by detectives of the Woosung-Shanghai Defence
Commissioner's Headquarters on suspicion that he was
concerned in the assassination of General Yang Young Tai
and Mr. Tang Yu Jen, Vice Minister of Foreign Affairs.
The Chinese authorities should
follow the proper procedure when they desire the arrest
of an important political suspect in the International
Settlement. In the case of the arrest of Mr. Lieu Loo
Yin they have failed to observe this procedure. Their
action is likely to give rise to a serious question
between the Chinese authorities and the S.M.C. The
S.M.P. will not lodge a protest, but the Municipal Council
should take up the matter and lodge a protest.

The Mainichi publishes the
following leading article:-
After the close of the Third
Plenary Session, the Central Standing Committee discharged
Mr. Lieu Loo Yin from the Central Propaganda Department
while the Executive Yuan dismissed Mr. Lieu Ki Vung, who
belongs to the same clique as Mr. Lieu Loo Yin, from
the Kwantung Provincial Government, and appointed General
Li Tsung Jen and General Pah Soong Hsi as Commander-in-Chief
and Vice Commander-in-Chief respectively of the Fifth
Route Army. Mr. Lieu Loo Yin was arrested in Shanghai
on February 24. General Li and General Pah will dissolve
the Independent Fourth Army and on March 1 will take up
their new positions with the Central Government.

1937年2月26日。

《每日新闻》

田岛副总监辞职

2月26日下午4时，日本街道工会联合会常务委员会将在日本俱乐部举行会议，审议工部局警务处田岛副总监的辞职事宜。

丰田纱厂案件重现

丰田纱厂罢工是由该厂工人代表孙燕泰（Sun Yen Tai，音译）被刺引发的，导致对曹家渡巡捕房的袭击以及当值警官受伤。此次风波最终由总工会平息。
2月23日，上海地方法院检察署派遣数名官员前往曹家渡巡捕房，进行袭击事件的重现演练。市政府警察局第三科对曹家渡巡捕房负责警官进行了问话笔录。该笔录已转送检察署。

刘芦英先生被捕

国民党中央执行委员会委员刘芦英先生，因涉嫌参与刺杀杨永泰将军及外交部次长唐有壬先生，在公共租界扬州饭店门前被淞沪警备司令部侦探逮捕。
中国当局若要在公共租界逮捕重要政治嫌疑犯，应遵循正当程序。在逮捕刘芦英先生一案中，他们未能遵守此程序。此举很可能在中国当局与工部局之间引发严重问题。工部局警务处不会提出抗议，但工部局董事会应介入此事并提出抗议。

《每日新闻》发表以下社论：
三中全会闭幕后，中央常务委员会免去了刘芦英先生在中央宣传部的职务，同时行政院罢免了与刘芦英同属一派的刘纪文（Lieu Ki Vung，音译）在广东省政府的职务，并任命李宗仁将军和白崇禧将军（Pah Soong Hsi，音译）分别为第五路军总司令和副总司令。刘芦英于2月24日在上海被捕。李将军和白将军将解散独立第四军，并于3月1日赴中央政府就任新职。

February 26. 1937.

Political significance is
attached to the arrest of Mr. Lieu Loo Yin because of his
anti-Central Government activities as well as the
assassination of General Yang Young Tai and Mr. Tang Yu
Jen. General Li and General Pah's obedience to the
Central Government and the loyalty of Kwangsi are also
worthy of attention.

Mr. Lieu Loo Yin played an
important part in bringing about co-operation between
General Chiang Kai Shek and Mr. Hu Han Min when the
latter returned to China from abroad. After the Second
Plenary Session in July, 1936, Mr. Lieu Loo Yin was
appointed Chief of the Central Propaganda Department,
but he failed in this work. He returned to the South
and prevented Mr. Hu Han Min from coming to Nanking and
worked against the Central Government. After Mr. Hu Han
Min's death he succeeded in persuading the military leaders
in the two Kwangs to oppose the Central Government. Mr.
Lieu also attempted to bring together the popular front
and the remaining members of the revolutionary independent
government established in Fukien. He is believed to be
connected with the Sian incident. It is not certain
whether he is the principal in the assassination of
General Yang Young Tai and Mr. Tang Yu Jen, but it is
undeniable that the assassinations were planned by him.
Mr. Lieu is dangerous to the Nanking Government because
of late he was actively engaged in an attempt to establish
an independent government. For this reason, he was
arrested by the Nanking Government as a warning to other
radical elements who are opposed to Nanking.

1937年2月26日。

刘芦英先生被捕具有政治意义，这不仅因为他参与了杨永泰将军和唐有壬先生的刺杀案，还因为他的反中央政府活动。李将军和白将军对中央政府的服从以及广西的忠诚也值得关注。

在胡汉民先生从海外归国时，刘芦英先生在促成蒋介石将军与胡汉民先生合作方面发挥了重要作用。1936年7月二中全会后，刘芦英先生被任命为中央宣传部部长，但他在此项工作中未能取得成功。他返回南方，阻止胡汉民先生前往南京，并从事反对中央政府的活动。胡汉民先生去世后，他成功说服两广军事领导人反对中央政府。刘先生还试图联合人民阵线以及在福建建立的革命独立政府的残余成员。据信他与西安事变有关联。虽然尚不确定他是否是刺杀杨永泰将军和唐有壬先生的主谋，但不可否认的是，这些刺杀行动是由他策划的。由于刘先生近期积极从事建立独立政府的活动，他对南京政府构成威胁。因此，南京政府逮捕了他，以警告其他反对南京的激进分子。

February 26, 1937. Morning Translation-1

Sin Wan Pao publishes the following telegram from Hankow :-

THE MURDER OF GENERAL YANG YUNG TAI

Zung Sih Chao(成賢超), one of the two men accused of the murder of General Yang Yung Tai, former Chairman of the Hupeh Provincial Government, has several aliases. His real name is Tan Wen Sing(譚文信). He is a native of Kweichow Province, not Szechuen.

Hsiao Sheh Shu(蕭若虛) is a member of the staff of the Central Kuomintang Headquarters, but he does not play an important part in this case. Hsiao Sheh Shu and ten other prisoners, among whom are two university professors, have been removed from Shanghai and Nanking to Hankow for imprisonment there. Yang Er Chien(楊尔謙) and his accomplices are still at large. The evidence discovered in Hongkong bears the signature of Mr. Lieu Loo Ying, a member of the Central Executive Committee of the Kuomintang, and shows that it was he who had planned the murder. Mr. Licu Ziu Bang(劉祖邦), Chief of the Military Court of the Field Headquarters in Hankow, who is handling the case, proceeded to Nanking the other day to submit a report.

The case was twice tried at Field Headquarters on February 10 and 12, and it was generally believed at the time that Tan Wen Sing and Chun Pah Chow(春柏舟), the actual murderers, would be given capital punishment, while the other prisoners would be referred to the Supreme Court at Nanking to be dealt with. Subsequently, telegraphic instructions were received from Nanking ordering the Field Headquarters to postpone the passing of sentence on the prisoners, because of the discovery at Hongkong of new evidence relating to Mr. Lieu Loo Ying's intrigues. The new evidence was taken by Mr. Yu Tseh(余澤), a Departmental Chief of the Police Bureau of Nanking, to Hankow where, after photostatic copies had been made, it was again brought back to Nanking.

After murdering General Yang Yung Tai, Chun Pah Chow fled to Shanghai. Enquiries showed that he was on intimate terms with a prostitute named Lau San(老三) in Hankow. The girl was persuaded to come to Shanghai by air, but Chun Pah Chow had gone to Nanking and subsequently to Wuhu where he was finally apprehended and escorted back to Hankow.

Mr. Lieu Loo Ying had organized two reactionary bodies known as the "Revolutionary Army Group" and the "Chinese Youth Special Affairs Corps" whose agents are scattered throughout the country for the purpose of murdering important officials of the Party and government. Generals Chang Chun, Yang Yung Tai, Huang Fu and others were marked for assassination. It is learned that members of the "Revolutionary Army Group" are required to take an oath when joining; the oath contains this injunction: "Obey the directions of Mr. Lieu Loo Ying."

The following persons have been arrested and detained at the Military Gaol at Hankow for their part in the murder of General Yang Yung Tai:- chief culprits: Zung Sih Chao (alias Tan Wen Sing) and Chun Pah Chow; suspects: Lo Zing Ning(羅靜寧), Wen Mou Kung(文茂宮), Koo Ih Van(顧一凡), Yang Gee Sing(楊其新), Hsiao Sheh Shu(蕭若虛), Zao Ping Yoong(曹炳榮), Wong Kwang Tsong(王光宗), Huang Ching Ling(黃正麟), Yoch Chien Chung(葉建中), Ling Yoong Chung(林用中), Yang Siang Van(楊象雲), Ho Juin Ching(何潤卿), Chiang Teh Zeng(蔣德增), Li Chuh Chien(李竹堅) and one female.

1937年2月26日。晨间译件-1

《新闻报》刊登了来自汉口的如下电文：

杨永泰将军遇刺案

被控谋杀前湖北省政府主席杨永泰将军的两名男子之一，成贤超（Zung Sih Chao），有多个别名。其真名为谭文信（Tan Wen Sing）。他是贵州省人，而非四川省人。

萧若虚（Hsiao Sheh Shu）是国民党中央总部的工作人员，但他在本案中并不扮演重要角色。萧若虚与其他十名囚犯（其中包括两名大学教授）已从上海和南京被转移至汉口监禁。杨尔谦（Yang Er Chien）及其同伙仍在逃。在香港发现的证据上有国民党中央执行委员刘芦隐（Lieu Loo Ying）先生的签名，显示是他策划了这起谋杀案。负责处理此案的汉口行营军法处处长刘祖邦（Licu Ziu Bang）先生日前前往南京提交报告。

该案曾于2月10日和12日在行营进行了两次审讯，当时普遍认为实际凶手谭文信和春柏舟（Chun Pah Chow）将被判处死刑，而其他囚犯将被移送南京最高法院处理。随后，收到南京发来的电报指示，命令行营推迟对囚犯的判决，原因是香港发现了涉及刘芦隐先生阴谋的新证据。新证据由南京市公安局科长余泽（Yu Tseh）先生带往汉口，在制作复印本后，又被带回南京。

春柏舟在谋杀杨永泰将军后逃往上海。调查显示，他与汉口一名名叫老三（Lau San）的妓女关系亲密。该女子被说服乘飞机来到上海，但春柏舟已前往南京，随后又去了芜湖，他在那里最终被捕并被押解回汉口。

刘芦隐先生组织了两个反动团体，分别称为“革命军集团”和“中国青年特种事务队”，其特工遍布全国，旨在谋杀党政要员。张群将军、杨永泰将军、黄郛将军等人被列为暗杀目标。据悉，“革命军集团”成员在加入时需宣誓；誓词中包含这一指令：“服从刘芦隐先生的指示。”

以下人员因参与谋杀杨永泰将军一案已被逮捕并关押在汉口军事监狱：主犯：成贤超（别名谭文信）和春柏舟；嫌疑人：罗静宁（Lo Zing Ning）、文茂宫（Wen Mou Kung）、顾一凡（Koo Ih Van）、杨其新（Yang Gee Sing）、萧若虚（Hsiao Sheh Shu）、曹炳荣（Zao Ping Yoong）、王光宗（Wong Kwang Tsong）、黄正麟（Huang Ching Ling）、叶建中（Yoch Chien Chung）、林用中（Ling Yoong Chung）、杨象云（Yang Siang Van）、何润卿（Ho Juin Ching）、蒋德增（Chiang Teh Zeng）、李竹坚（Li Chuh Chien）及一名女性。

February 25, 1937. Morning Translation.

Shun Pao and other local newspapers:

ARREST OF C.E.C. MEMBER

At 1.30 a.m. February 24, Mr. Lieu Loo Ying
(劉隱), a member of the Central Executive Committee of
the Kuomintang, was arrested by detectives of the Shanghai
City Government Police Bureau in front of the Yangtsze
Hotel (揚子飯店), Yunnan Road, where he has been staying
since February 21 after attending the Third Plenary Session
at Nanking. At the time of his arrest, Mr. Lieu was
accompanied by his wife. His arrest is due to definite
proof having been found connecting him with the murder of
Mr. Tang Yu Jen (唐有壬), the former Vice-Minister of
Foreign Affairs, and General Yang Yung Tai (楊永泰), the
former Chairman of the Hupeh Provincial Government.
Mr. Lieu was brought before Judge Feng Shu Teh
(馮樹德) at the Shanghai First Special District Court at
10 a.m. yesterday. An application was made by Mr. Paul
Y. Ru, Assistant Municipal Advocate, for a writ of detention
against Mr. Lieu and was granted.
The case was adjourned till Monday next, March 1.
As Mr. Lieu is a member of the C.E.C. of the
Kuomintang, he is being well treated by the S.M.P. and has
a room to himself at the Louza Police Station.

Shun Pao (Nanking telegram):

Diligent enquiries at various quarters elicited
the information that Mr. Lieu Loo Ying had, some few years
ago, secretly organized a reactionary body known as the
"Revolutionary Army Group," with himself as the leader.
He also formed the "Chinese Youth Special Affairs Corps"
with agents at Nanking, Hupeh, Shanghai and other places,
to undertake assassinations. He appropriated a monthly
allowance of $2,000 for the expenses of the Corps and
entrusted one Hsiao Zu Wen (蕭祖文), his follower, to manage
the Corps. In addition, he posted communications agents
in Kiangsu, Chekiang, Anhwei, Kiangsi, Hupeh, Nanking and
Shanghai, and earmarked a sum of $1,000 for the expenses.
Special attention was paid to Shanghai and Hupeh.
Following the murder of General Yang Yung Tai in
Hankow last year, the authorities arrested two men named
Ting Sih Chao (丁思昭) and Chun Fah Chow (周春發) and
a number of accomplices. When questioned, the prisoners
admitted that it was one Yang Er Chien (楊爾謙), an
accomplice, who originated the plot on instructions from
Lieu Loo Ying, and that Yang had also attempted to murder
other important officials after the assassination of
General Yang Yung Tai. Yang Er Chien's address in Shanghai
was later secured, but he managed to escape before the
arrival of the detectives. A watch was kept at his home
in Shanghai. One day a man named Hsiao Sheh Shu (蕭攝書),
who had arrived in Shanghai from Hongkong, proceeded directly
to Yang's home to pay a call. Hsiao Sheh Shu was arrested
by the officers and on being interrogated, he stated that
he saw Hsiao Zu Wen at Lieu Loo Ying's home in Hongkong,
that after he was told of General Yang Yung Tai's murder
he was asked to go to Shanghai to instruct Yang Er Chien

1937年2月25日。晨间译件。

《申报》及其他本地报纸：

中央执行委员被捕

2月24日凌晨1时30分，国民党中央执行委员刘蘆隱（Lieu Loo Ying）先生在云南路扬子饭店（Yangtsze Hotel）门前被上海市政府警察局侦探逮捕，他自参加南京第三次全体会议后，于2月21日起一直住在此处。被捕时，刘先生由其妻子陪同。逮捕他的原因是发现了确凿证据，将他与前外交部次长唐有壬（Tang Yu Jen）先生和前湖北省政府主席杨永泰（Yang Yung Tai）将军的谋杀案联系起来。
昨天上午10时，刘先生在上海第一特区地方法院出庭，由冯树德（Feng Shu Teh）法官审理。助理市检察官保罗·Y·鲁（Paul Y. Ru）先生申请对刘先生签发拘留令，并获得批准。
案件延期至下周一，即3月1日审理。
由于刘先生是国民党中央执行委员会成员，工部局警务处对他待遇良好，他在老闸捕房拥有单独的房间。

《申报》（南京电）：

经多方勤勉查访，获悉刘蘆隱先生于数年前秘密组织了一个名为“革命军集团”的反动团体，并自任首领。他还组建了“中国青年特种事务队”，在南京、湖北、上海等地设有特工，从事暗杀活动。他每月拨出2,000元作为该队的经费，并委托其追随者萧祖文（Hsiao Zu Wen）管理该队。此外，他在江苏、浙江、安徽、江西、湖北、南京和上海设立了通讯特工，并拨款1,000元作为经费。上海和湖北受到特别关注。
去年杨永泰将军在汉口遇刺后，当局逮捕了两名分别名为丁思昭（Ting Sih Chao）和周春发（Chun Fah Chow）的男子以及多名同伙。经讯问，囚犯承认是同伙杨尔谦（Yang Er Chien）奉刘蘆隱之命策划了该阴谋，并且杨在刺杀杨永泰将军后还企图谋杀其他重要官员。后来获得了杨尔谦在上海的地址，但在侦探到达之前他设法逃脱了。对其在上海的住所进行了监视。一天，一名名叫萧摄书（Hsiao Sheh Shu）的男子从香港抵达上海后，直接前往杨家拜访。萧摄书被警员逮捕，经讯问，他称在香港刘蘆隱家中见过萧祖文，在得知杨永泰将军被杀的消息后，他被要求前往上海口头指示杨尔谦

February 25, 1937. Morning Translation.

verbally to return immediately to Hongkong. The prisoner
added that the murder of General Yang Yung Tai was
instigated by Lieu Loo Ying.
With Lieu Loo Ying now under arrest, it is learned
that the authorities will make public Lieu Loo Ying's
reactionary organizations and assassination plans.
It is also learned that Lieu Loo Ying is
suspected of having a part in the murder in Shanghai, 1935,
of Mr. Tang Yu Jen, former Minister of Foreign Affairs.

Shanghai Evening News of February 24:

Mr. Lieu Loo Ying's Antecedents

(永丰), Mr. Lieu Loo Ying is a native of Yung Foong
Kiangsi Province. He studied in California
University, and graduated with B.A. degree. Whilst in
America, he acted as the chief executive officer of the
Chinese Kuomintang Branch in the United States and edited
the "Young China." Upon his return to China, he was
appointed head of the Social Science Department of Futan
University and professor of Chi Tse University and Chung
San University. He is also member of the C.E.C. of the
Kuomintang, a member of the National Government, Acting
Vice President of the Examination Yuan, and Chief of the
Propaganda Department of the Kuomintang. He was a close
follower of Mr. Hu Han Min, the late Chairman of the Central
Standing Committee of the Kuomintang. He is known as
an active member of the Neo Kuomintang Party. Following
Mr. Hu Han Min's death, he edited the publication of a
monthly periodical called the "Three Principles of the People."
During the Kwangtung and Kwangsi trouble last
year, he went to Kwangsi from Hongkong and undertook
propaganda against the Central Government. Following the
peaceful settlement of the Kwangtung and Kwangsi affair, he
visited Nanking but returned to Hongkong shortly afterwards.
After Mr. Hu Han Lin's death, he attempted to lead Hu Han
Lin's Clique and to reorganize it into a Neo Kuomintang
Party, but he failed.
Recently he went to Nanking to attend the Third
Plenary Session. He came to Shanghai before the close
of the conference. At first he stayed with a friend off
Route Maresca but later he registered at the Yangtsze Hotel.

1937年2月25日。晨间译件。

立即返回香港。该囚犯补充说，杨永泰将军的谋杀案是由刘蘆隱煽动的。
随着刘蘆隱现在被捕，据悉当局将公布刘蘆隱的反动组织和暗杀计划。
另据悉，刘蘆隱涉嫌参与了1935年在上海发生的前外交部长唐有壬先生的谋杀案。

2月24日《上海晚邮报》：

刘蘆隱先生的生平背景

刘蘆隱先生是江西省永丰（Yung Foong）人。他就读于加州大学，并获得文学士学位。在美国期间，他担任中国国民党美国支部的主要执行官，并编辑《少年中国》杂志。回国后，他被任命为复旦大学社会科学系主任，以及暨南大学和中山大学的教授。他还是国民党中央执行委员会委员、国民政府委员、考试院代理副院长以及国民党宣传部长。他是已故国民党中央常务委员会主席胡汉民先生的密切追随者。他被称为新国民党派的活跃分子。胡汉民去世后，他编辑了一份名为《三民主义》的月刊。
在去年两广事变期间，他从香港前往广西，从事反对中央政府的宣传活动。在两广事变和平解决后，他访问了南京，但不久后又返回香港。胡汉林（Hu Han Lin）去世后，他试图领导胡汉林派系并将其重组为新国民党，但未成功。
最近他前往南京参加第三次全体会议。会议结束前他来到上海。起初他住在马思南路附近的一位朋友家，后来登记入住扬子饭店。

February 25, 1937. Morning Translation

Shun Pao and other local newspapers:

ARREST OF C.E.C. MEMBER

At 1.30 a.m. February 24, Mr. Lieu Loo Ying
(劉蘆隱), a member of the Central Executive Committee of
the Kuomintang, was arrested by detectives of the Shanghai
City Government Police Bureau in front of the Yangtsze
Hotel (揚子飯店), Yunnan Road, where he has been staying
since February 21 after attending the Third Plenary Session
at Nanking. At the time of his arrest, Mr. Lieu was
accompanied by his wife. His arrest is due to definite
proof having been found connecting him with the murder of
Mr. Tang Yu Jen (唐有壬), the former Vice-Minister of
Foreign Affairs, and General Yang Yung Tai (楊永泰), the
former Chairman of the Hupeh Provincial Government.
Mr. Lieu was brought before Judge Feng Shu Teh
(馮士德) at the Shanghai First Special District Court at
10 a.m. yesterday. An application was made by Mr. Paul
Y. Ru, Assistant Municipal Advocate, for a writ of detention
against Mr. Lieu and was granted.
The case was adjourned till Monday next, March 1.
As Mr. Lieu is a member of the C.E.C. of the
Kuomintang, he is being well treated by the S.M.P. and has
a room to himself at the Louza Police Station.

Shun Pao (Nanking telegram):

Diligent enquiries at various quarters elicited
the information that Mr. Lieu Loo Ying had, some few years
ago, secretly organized a reactionary body known as the
"Revolutionary Army Group," with himself as the leader.
He also formed the "Chinese Youth Special Affairs Corps"
with agents at Nanking, Hupeh, Shanghai and other places,
to undertake assassinations. He appropriated a monthly
allowance of $2,000 for the expenses of the Corps and
entrusted one Hsiao Zu Wen (蕭祖文), his follower, to manage
the Corps. In addition, he posted communications agents
in Kiangsu, Chekiang, Anhwei, Kiangsi, Hupeh, Nanking and
Shanghai, and earmarked a sum of $1,000 for the expenses.
Special attention was paid to Shanghai and Hupeh.
Following the murder of General Yang Yung Tai in
Hankow last year, the authorities arrested two men named
Tang Sih Chao (唐世超) and Chun Fah Chow (周春發) and
a number of accomplices. When questioned, the prisoners
admitted that it was one Yang Er Chien (楊爾謙), an
accomplice, who originated the plot on instructions from
Lieu Loo Ying, and that Yang had also attempted to murder
other important officials after the assassination of
General Yang Yung Tai. Yang Er Chien's address in Shanghai
was later secured, but he managed to escape before the
arrival of the detectives. A watch was kept at his home
in Shanghai. One day a man named Hsiao Sheh Shu (蕭社樹),
who had arrived in Shanghai from Hongkong, proceeded directly
to Yang's home to pay a call. Hsiao Sheh Shu was arrested
by the officers and on being interrogated, he stated that
he saw Hsiao Zu Wen at Lieu Leo Ying's home in Hongkong,
that after he was told of General Yang Yung Tai's murder
he was asked to go to Shanghai to instruct Yang Er Chien

《申报》及其他本地报纸：

中央执行委员被捕

2月24日凌晨1时30分，国民党中央执行委员刘蘆隱（Lieu Loo Ying）先生在云南路扬子饭店（Yangtsze Hotel）门前被上海市政府警察局侦探逮捕，他自参加南京第三次全体会议后，于2月21日起一直住在此处。被捕时，刘先生由其妻子陪同。逮捕他的原因是发现了确凿证据，将他与前外交部次长唐有壬（Tang Yu Jen）先生和前湖北省政府主席杨永泰（Yang Yung Tai）将军的谋杀案联系起来。
昨天上午10时，刘先生在上海第一特区地方法院出庭，由冯士德（Feng Shu Teh）法官审理。助理市检察官保罗·Y·鲁（Paul Y. Ru）先生申请对刘先生签发拘留令，并获得批准。
案件延期至下周一，即3月1日审理。
由于刘先生是国民党中央执行委员会成员，工部局警务处对他待遇良好，他在老闸捕房拥有单独的房间。

《申报》（南京电）：

经多方勤勉查访，获悉刘蘆隱先生于数年前秘密组织了一个名为“革命军集团”的反动团体，并自任首领。他还组建了“中国青年特种事务队”，在南京、湖北、上海等地设有特工，从事暗杀活动。他每月拨出2,000元作为该队的经费，并委托其追随者萧祖文（Hsiao Zu Wen）管理该队。此外，他在江苏、浙江、安徽、江西、湖北、南京和上海设立了通讯特工，并拨款1,000元作为经费。上海和湖北受到特别关注。
去年杨永泰将军在汉口遇刺后，当局逮捕了两名分别名为唐世超（Tang Sih Chao）和周春发（Chun Fah Chow）的男子以及多名同伙。经讯问，囚犯承认是同伙杨尔谦（Yang Er Chien）奉刘蘆隱之命策划了该阴谋，并且杨在刺杀杨永泰将军后还企图谋杀其他重要官员。后来获得了杨尔谦在上海的地址，但在侦探到达之前他设法逃脱了。对其在上海的住所进行了监视。一天，一名名叫萧社树（Hsiao Sheh Shu）的男子从香港抵达上海后，直接前往杨家拜访。萧社树被警员逮捕，经讯问，他称在香港刘Leo英（Lieu Leo Ying）家中见过萧祖文，在得知杨永泰将军被杀的消息后，他被要求前往上海口头指示杨尔谦

With Lieu Loo Ying now under arrest, it is learned that the authorities will make public Lieu Loo Ying's reactionary organizations and assassination plans.
It is also learned that Lieu Loo Ying is suspected of having a part in the murder in Shanghai, 1935, of Mr. Tang Yu Jen, former Minister of Foreign Affairs.

Shanghai Evening News of February 24:

Mr. Lieu Loo Ying's Antecedents

(永丰), Mr. Lieu Loo Ying is a native of Yung Foong Kiangsi Province. He studied in California University, and graduated with B.A. degree. Whilst in America, he acted as the chief executive officer of the Chinese Kuomintang Branch in the United States and edited the "Young China." Upon his return to China, he was appointed head of the Social Science Department of Futan University and professor of Chi Tse University and Chung San University. He is also member of the C.E.C. of the Kuomintang, a member of the National Government, Acting Vice President of the Examination Yuan, and Chief of the Propaganda Department of the Kuomintang. He was a close follower of Mr. Hu Han Min, the late Chairman of the Central Standing Committee of the Kuomintang. He is known as an active member of the Neo Kuomintang Party. Following Mr. Hu Han Min's death, he edited the publication of a monthly periodical called the "Three Principles of the People."
During the Kwangtung and Kwangsi trouble last year, he went to Kwangsi from Hongkong and undertook propaganda against the Central Government. Following the peaceful settlement of the Kwangtung and Kwangsi affair, he visited Nanking but returned to Hongkong shortly afterwards. After Mr. Hu Han Lin's death, he attempted to lead Hu Han Lin's Clique and to reorganize it into a Neo Kuomintang Party, but he failed.
Recently he went to Nanking to attend the Third Plenary Session. He came to Shanghai before the close of the conference. At first he stayed with a friend off Route Maresca but later he registered at the Yangtsze Hotel.

2月24日《上海晚新闻》：

刘芦英先生履历

刘芦英先生籍贯江西永丰。他曾就读于加州大学，获文学士学位。在美期间，他担任中国国民党美国支部的主要负责人，并编辑《少年中国》杂志。回国后，他被任命为复旦大学社会科学系主任，以及暨南大学和中山大学教授。他还是国民党中央执行委员会委员、国民政府委员、考试院代理副院长以及国民党宣传部长。他是已故国民党中央常务委员会主席胡汉民先生的亲信追随者。他被视为新国民党派的活跃成员。胡汉民去世后，他编辑了一份名为《三民主义》的月刊。
在去年两广事变期间，他从香港前往广西，从事反对中央政府的宣传活动。两广事变和平解决后，他曾访问南京，但不久后又返回香港。胡汉林（Hu Han Lin，原文如此，疑为胡汉民之误）死后，他试图领导胡汉林派系并将其改组为新国民党，但未成功。
最近他前往南京参加第三届中央全会。会议结束前他来到上海。起初他借住在马思南路（Route Maresca）附近的一位朋友家中，后来入住扬子饭店。

February 25, 1937.

MAILICI

JAPANESE MARINES TO HOLD SHAM FIGHT

At an early hour on February 26
a large body of the Japanese naval landing party and
a section of bluejackets from Japanese warships now in
port will hold a sham fight in the area east of North
Szechuen Road(Settlement) and along North Szechuen
Road extension. Rear-Admiral Okochi will
direct the operations.

NICHI-NICHI

MR. AMANO CALLS ON MUNICIPAL TREASURER

At 10.30 a.m. February 24 Mr.
Amano, Chairman of the Japanese Residents Corporation,
called on Mr. Ford, Treasurer of the S.M.C., and informed
him of the financial difficulties of the Corporation.
He desires to secure more grants from the S.M.C.

CHINA TO ISSUE MILITARY BONDS

A special telegram from Nanking
dated February 24 reports that General Chiang Kai Shek
is making war preparations against Japan. He is reported
to be negotiating with financial circles in Shanghai
for the issue of military bonds for use in the re-
organization of the national army and to expand the air
force.

ARREST OF MR. LIEU LOO YING AND KWANGSI PARTY'S
ATTITUDE

The arrest of Mr. Lieu Loo Ying
by officers of the Woosung Shanghai Defence Commissioner's
headquarters was not effected with the assistance of the
Municipal Police. This is likely to give rise to
serious political question.
Mr. Lieu Loo Ying was formerly
the right hand man of the late Hu Han Min as well as
of the South-West Party. After Hu Han Min's death
Mr. Lieu became very active in close touch with General
Li Tsung Jen and Pah Soong Hsi.
It is interesting to watch what
attitude Generals Li and Pah will adopt towards Mr. Lieu's
arrest which has come at a time when the relations
between the South-West Party and Nanking are becoming
closer.

天野先生拜访工部局财务长

2月24日上午10时30分，日本居留民团团长天野先生拜访了工部局财务长福特先生，并向其通报了居留民团的财政困难。他希望从工部局获得更多的拨款。

中国将发行军事公债

来自南京的2月24日专电报道，蒋介石将军正在做对日作战准备。据报道，他正与上海金融界谈判，拟发行军事公债，用于重组国军及扩充空军。

刘芦英先生被捕及桂系态度

吴淞上海防守司令部官员逮捕刘芦英先生一事，并未得到警务处的协助。这可能会引发严重的政治问题。
刘芦英先生曾是已故胡汉民以及西南派系的得力助手。胡汉民死后，刘芦英变得非常活跃，与李宗仁将军和白崇禧将军保持密切联系。
值得关注的是，在西南派系与南京方面关系日益密切之际，李将军和白将军将对刘芦英被捕一事采取何种态度。

The Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury, Friday, June 18, 1937

Liu Makes High
Tribunal Appeal

Suspended CEC Man
Fights Ten-year
Jail Term

Three days before the expiration of the time-limit for an appeal, suspended member of the CEC Executive Committee of the Kuomintang, yesterday filed an appeal with the High Court in Wuchang against the ten-year jail term imposed by the Wuchang District Court on charges of instigating the murder of General Teng Tse-ming, the late chairman of the Hunan provincial government, last October.

The former influential South-west politician is also fighting against the Wuchang District Court decisions depriving him of civil rights for five years and requiring him to pay jointly with three other convicted murderers $50,000 compensation and $10,000 heart-balm to the survivors of the assassinated governor.

Declaring that the judgment was rendered entirely on basis of imagination, Mr. Liu asked the High Court to order a speedy trial and acquittal. He took strong exception to the lower court judge who, he pointed out, ruled out all of the points in his favor. The "China Youth Anti-Japanese and Traitor Extermination Special Service Corps" which he organized in Canton, he said, was reduced by the judge to "China Youth Traitor Extermination Special Service Corps," thus hiding the genuine motive of the organization.

Mr. Liu was sentenced in the Wuchang court sometime ago. Three others were also sentenced, one to death, on charges of being the murderers. Following the pronouncement of the sentences, the Teng family filed an appeal with the High Court praying for the supreme penalty for the alleged murderer, Mr. Liu. The latter lodged the first appeal after Mr. Liu submitted his petition yesterday.

THE SHANGHAI SUNDAY TIMES, JUNE 6, 1937
Former Kuomintang Officer
Gets 10-Year Sentence
Two Others Must Pay Supreme Penalty For Killing
Of Hupeh Governor; Payment Of $200,000
Also Ordered; Liu Makes Appeal

Mr. Liu Lu-ying, suspended member of the Central Executive Committee and a well known politician in the South-West, was sentenced to 10 years' imprisonment yesterday by the Wuchang District Court for instigation of the assassination last year of General Yang Yung-tai, late Governor of Hupeh. Cheng Hsichao and Kung Po-chou, who were found to have actually participated in the shooting of General Yang, were sentenced to death. Tsao Ping-yung was sentenced to life imprisonment and Yang Chi-hsin was given two years. The other accused were acquitted.
Besides being given prison terms, the accused were also sentenced to pay $200,000 to the family of the deceased governor and $10,000 as the "comfort fee." It was learnt that the accused had told the judge that they would appeal against the judgment.
The passing of the sentences yesterday concluded one of the most important political crimes ever committed in this country. It will be recalled that General Yang was brutally shot and killed at a wharf in Wuchang after attending a meeting. Cheng Shih-chao, the murderer, was caught red-handed and through his confession the other accused were arrested. Mr. Liu Lu-ying, who was alleged to be the organizer and financial supporter of the assassination gang, was arrested in Shanghai more than a month ago while he was about to leave the Yangtze Hotel with his wife.

Final Dramatic Plea
HANKOW, June 5.—The final hearing of the case against Mr. Liu Yu-yin, suspended member of the C.E.C., and seven other suspects accused of complicity in the assassination of Mr. Yang Yung-tai, the late Chairman of the Hupeh Provincial Government, was held yesterday at the Wucnang District Court.
Judge Liu Hsien-chi, of the Criminal Division, presided. Besides Mr. Liu Lu-yin, the other accused present were Cheng Hsi-chao, Kung Po-chou, Tsao Ping-yung, Yang Chihshin, Li Chun-chien, Nieh Ching-chuan, and Wen Mao-kuan. Mr. Liu wore an old flannel suit and appeared to be sick.
After explaining the charges against the accused, Mr. Chu Cheng-tsan, the Public Procurator, said that, by order of the Procuratorate attached to the Hupeh Provincial High Court, the Court is requested also to investigate the attack on General Chiang Tso-pin, Minister of Interior, on National Independence Day (October 10) last year at the Capital when Minister Chiang's motor car was struck by a bullet.

Denies Complicity
Mr. Liu Lu-yin was then called to the stand. He said that he did not instigate the assassination of the late Mr. Yang Yung-tai. In fact, he added, he had never even "dreamt of committing such a crime." He had been a disciple of Dr. Sun Yat-sen, the late Party Leader, for a number of years, and had been engaged principally in literary work. He said that he had never been entrusted with any post of concrete political responsibility.
Continuing, Mr. Liu said that he cared little for fame and wealth. Because of his utter disregard for fame and wealth, he sacrificed the posts of Director of the Central Party Publicity Department and Vice-President of the Examination Yuan, which he had declined when offered to him.
"Since I am not interested in fame and wealth, how can I be accused of scrambling for power and profit?" he added. He said that he had been connected with the Kuomintang for more than 20 years. Although he had achieved nothing for the Party, he has always loved and defended the Party and has faith in the Central authorities, especially General Chiang Kai-shek, President of the Military Affairs Commission.

Hongkong Statement
When the latter was in captivity in Sian last year, he (the accused) was seriously concerned over General Chiang's personal safety, and issued a statement in a newspaper in Hongkong opposing the use of military force against the Sian rebels for fear of possible danger to General Chiang's life.
Mr. Yang Yung-tai, the accused said, was one of his friends. If Mr. Yang's family is in financial difficulties, he (the accused) is willing to assist them in his private capacity as a friend, but not as a responsibility imposed by Law. The family of the late Mr. Yang, it will be noted, has filed a suit for damages against Mr. Liu Lu-yin for instigating the assassination.
The accused added that General Chiang Kai-shek is a faithful disciple of the late Dr. Sun Yat-sen and the responsible leader of the Central Government. He said that he has complete confidence in General Chiang and had never investigated the latter's movements with a view to doing him harm.
The accused then said that he would leave the legal aspects of his defence to the care of his lawyer, and requested Judge Liu for permission to leave the Court on account of fatigue and illness. The request was granted.
Cheng Hsi-chao was next called to the stand. He said that he joined the assassination "organ" in September last year, and fired twice at Mr. Yang Yung-tai on October 25 last year.
Kung Po-chou, another accused, denied all responsibility for the crime. He said that he knew nothing about the attack on Minister Chiang Tso-pin's motor car in Nanking on October 10 last year.
Tsao Ping-yung, Yang Chi-hsin, Li Chun-chien, Nieh Ching-chuan and Wen Mao-kuan were then questioned. Their answers were similar to their depositions at previous hearings.
The lawyers for the defence and the prosecution then addressed the Court. The lawyer for the family of Mr. Yang Yung-tai, besides asking for damages, requested the Court to mete out the severest punishment to the accused.
The hearing was concluded at 2 p.m., after which the judges retired to deliberate and prepare the judgment of the Court.—Kup Min.

《上海星期泰晤士报》，1937年6月6日
前国民党军官
获刑十年
另两人因杀害湖北省长须受极刑；并判令赔偿20万美元；刘提出上诉

中央执行委员会停职委员、西南著名政客刘芦英先生，昨日被武昌地方法院以煽动刺杀前任湖北省长杨永泰将军罪，判处十年监禁。经查实实际参与枪击杨将军的程希超和孔伯周，被判处死刑。曹炳庸被判处无期徒刑，杨吉新被判处两年徒刑。其余被告均被宣告无罪。
除判处监禁外，被告还被判令向已故省长的家属支付20万美元，以及作为“抚慰费”的1万美元。据悉，被告已告知法官将对判决提出上诉。
昨日的宣判结束了该国历史上最重大的政治犯罪案件之一。人们记得，杨将军在参加一次会议后，于武昌某码头遭到残忍枪杀。凶手程世超（音译）被当场抓获，并通过其供词逮捕了其他被告。据称是刺杀团伙组织者和资金提供者的刘芦英先生，于一个多月前在上海被捕，当时他正与其妻子准备离开扬子饭店。

最后的戏剧性辩护
汉口，6月5日电。——针对中央执行委员会停职委员刘芦英先生及其他七名涉嫌共谋刺杀前任湖北省政府主席杨永泰先生的嫌疑人的案件，昨日在武昌地方法院进行了最后审理。
刑事庭法官刘显基（音译）主持庭审。除刘芦英外，出庭的其他被告包括程希超、孔伯周、曹炳庸、杨吉新、李春建、聂敬全（音译）和文茂官（音译）。刘先生身穿一套旧法兰绒西装，显得病态。
公诉人朱承赞（音译）在解释对被告的指控后表示，根据湖北高等法院检察处的命令，请求法庭同时调查去年国庆日（10月10日）在首都发生的对内政部长蒋作宾将军的袭击事件，当时蒋部长的汽车被子弹击中。

否认共谋
随后传召刘芦英先生出庭作证。他表示自己并未煽动刺杀已故的杨永泰先生。事实上，他补充说，他甚至从未“梦想过犯下此类罪行”。他曾是已故党领袖孙中山博士的门徒多年，主要从事文字工作。他说自己从未被委任任何具有具体政治责任的职位。
刘继续说道，他对名利毫不在意。正因为对名利的完全漠视，他拒绝了当向他提供中央党部宣传部部长和考试院副院长的职位。
“既然我对名利不感兴趣，又怎能被指责为争权夺利呢？”他补充道。他说自己与国民党已有二十多年的联系。虽然他为党并无建树，但他始终热爱并捍卫该党，并对中央当局，特别是军事委员会委员长蒋介石将军，抱有信念。

香港声明
去年蒋介石将军在西安被扣期间，他（被告）对蒋将军的人身安全深感担忧，并在香港一家报纸上发表声明，反对对西安叛乱者使用武力，以免危及蒋将军的生命。
被告称，杨永泰先生是他的朋友之一。如果杨先生的家庭面临经济困难，他（被告）愿意以朋友的私人身份提供帮助，但这并非法律强加的责任。值得注意的是，已故杨先生的家属已对刘芦英先生提起损害赔偿诉讼，指控其煽动刺杀。
被告补充说，蒋介石将军是已故孙中山博士的忠实信徒，也是中央政府的责任领导人。他说他对蒋将军充满信心，从未为了伤害后者而调查其行踪。
被告随后表示，他将把辩护的法律方面事宜交给律师处理，并以疲劳和疾病为由请求法官允许其离开法庭。该请求获准。
接下来传召程希超出庭。他说他于去年九月加入刺杀“组织”，并于去年10月25日向杨永泰先生开了两枪。
另一名被告孔伯周否认对该罪行承担任何责任。他说他对去年10月10日在南京袭击蒋作宾部长汽车一事一无所知。
随后对曹炳庸、杨吉新、李春建、聂敬全和文茂官进行了讯问。他们的回答与此前听证会上的证词相似。
随后，辩方和控方律师向法庭陈述。杨永泰先生家属的律师除了要求损害赔偿外，还请求法庭对被告施以最严厉的惩罚。
听证会于下午2时结束，随后法官退庭审议并准备法庭判决。——《国民报》

E CHINA PRESS, SUNDAY, JUNE 6, 1937

Liu Denies
Charges At
Hupeh Trial

Revolutionary Career
Told; Verdict Ex-
pected Soon

HANKOW, June 5.—(Central)—
Repetition of his flat denial to
charges of complicity in dastardly
attempts on the lives of five high
government officials, including Gen.
Chiang Kai-shek, was made by Liu
Lu-yin, former Chairman of the
Central Publicity Council, at the
third session of the open trial
against him and seven other sus-
pects yesterday.

The verdict of the trial, which
started last month, was expected
to be announced some time today.

Garbed in an old flannel suit and
wearing a forlorn look, Liu Lu-yin
strongly pleaded ignorance of all
the charges levelled against him,
namely complicity in the assassina-
tion of the late Gen. Yang Yung-
tai, former Chairman of the Hupeh
provincial government, last October
25, and in the attempt on the life
of Gen. Chiang Tso-pin, Minister
of Interior, last October 10 in
Nanking.

Relates Career

Going briefly into his some 20
years of revolutionary career, Liu de-
clared that he has always been a
faithful follower of the late Dr.
Sun Yat-sen, founder of the Kuo-
mintang, and of Gen. Chiang Kai-
shek, the recognized leader of China.

During all these years, however,
Liu continued, his work has been
mainly consisted in writing and not
in actual politics.

That he has never strongly in-
dulged in fighting for political
power, Liu said, could be proved that
the fact that he had twice given
up high positions in the Central
Government in order to devote his
time to bringing about a rapproche-
ment between Nanking and the
Southwest.

Stressing particularly his un-
wavering loyalty to and absolute
confidence in the Generalissimo,
Liu declared that when the Sian
Mutiny broke out last December,
he was greatly concerned over the
personal safety of the Generalis-
simo.

Because of his great concern over
the personal safety of Gen. Chiang,
Liu went on, he disapproved at
the time the policy of using force
in settling the Sian question, which
view he said was published in all
Hongkong papers.

Referring to the suit filed by the
family of the late Gen. Yang Yung-
tai, asking for compensation for the
education of the children, Liu
stated that he would be willing to
help in a private capacity, but not
as bound by legal obligations.

Liu also denied that he had ever
participated in any activities in
trailing the movements of the
Generalissimo.

Liu's Sentence Postponed

HANKOW, June 6.—(Central).—
In view of the delicacy of the Yang
Yung-tai murder case, the Wuchang
District Court has postponed its
pronouncement of the sentence on
Liu Lu-yin, former director of the
Central Publicity Department, and
his accomplices until tomorrow or
next Monday.

《字林西报》，1937年6月6日，星期日

刘在湖北审判中
否认指控

讲述革命生涯；
判决预计即将宣布

汉口，6月5日.—（中央社）— 前中央宣传委员会主任刘芦隐昨日在他与其他七名嫌疑犯的公开审判第三次庭审中，再次断然否认参与针对包括蒋介石将军在内的五名政府高官的卑鄙暗杀企图的指控。

这场于上月开始的审判，其判决预计将于今日某个时候宣布。

刘芦隐身穿一套旧法兰绒西装，神情凄凉，强烈辩称自己对所有针对他的指控一无所知，即参与去年10月25日暗杀已故湖北省政府主席杨永泰将军，以及参与去年10月10日在南京企图暗杀内政部长蒋作宾将军。

讲述生涯

刘简要回顾了自己约二十年的革命生涯，宣称他始终是国民党创始人孙中山博士的忠实追随者，也是中国公认领袖蒋介石将军的忠实追随者。

然而，刘继续说道，在这些年里，他的工作主要在于著述，而非实际政治活动。

刘表示，他从未热衷于争夺政治权力，这可以从他曾两次辞去中央政府的高位，以便 devote 时间促成南京与西南方面和解这一事实得到证明。

刘特别强调他对委员长的坚定不移的忠诚和绝对信任，宣称去年十二月西安事变爆发时，他极为关切委员长的人身安全。

刘接着说，出于对蒋将军人身安全的极大关切，他当时不赞成以武力解决西安问题的政策，并称这一观点曾刊登在所有香港报纸上。

谈及已故杨永泰将军家属提起的诉讼，要求赔偿子女教育费用一事，刘表示他愿意以个人身份提供帮助，但并非受法律义务约束。

刘还否认他曾参与任何跟踪委员长行踪的活动。

刘的判刑推迟

汉口，6月6日.—（中央社）.— 鉴于杨永泰谋杀案的敏感性，武昌地方法院已将前中央宣传部主任刘芦隐及其同伙的宣判推迟至明日或下周一。

即将宣判

武昌法院结束听证；
被告否认指控

武昌地方法院定于今日或明日对刘芦隐先生一案作出判决。刘是国民党中央执行委员会涉嫌成员，曾是西南派系的著名政客，被控涉嫌煽动谋杀已故湖北省主席杨永泰将军，策划杀害张群、蒋介石和余飞鹏（音译）将军，并组织暗杀小队。

刘是因“刘氏阴谋”指控受审的四名男子之一。其中包括赵世超（音译），一名年轻的前士兵，他供认去年10月28日在南京向杨将军开了两枪。

这起轰动案件的审判于昨日下午在武昌地方法院结束。庭审上午9时在座无虚席的法庭开始，直到晚上9时，当10名辩护律师和检察官完成辩论后才休庭。在审判期间，检察官请求法庭讯问被告是否参与了去年10月10日在南京对内政部长蒋太彬（音译）将军的未遂暗杀。据透露，当天蒋将军的汽车仅差一英寸就被击中，尽管部长本人未受伤。

所有被告均否认这项新指控。无人承认任何罪行，尽管部长并未受伤。

所有被告均否认新指控。无人承认参与暗杀杨永泰将军。刘先生再次 emphatically 否认针对他的指控，并补充说他是蒋介石将军的忠诚支持者。法庭最终于晚上9时退庭，并在闭门会议室进行了长时间的商议。除非出现新情况，否则判决预计将于今日或明日下达。

刘先生于今年二月在上海被捕，当时他在南京会见几位政府高官后返回上海。刘先生是一位受过美国教育的学者，是已故胡汉民先生的热情追随者。在两广事变期间，他在西南地区发挥了重要作用，监督了陈济棠将军的计划。当时陈自称为抗日联军总司令。

当陈被逐出广州后，刘先生前往上海，在那里进行反帝活动，直到李宗仁和白崇禧将军最终归顺并融入中央当局。

杨家
起诉刘

索赔218,560美元
官员死亡案；审判
继续进行

汉口，5月17日.—（中央社）— 武昌地方法院对前中央宣传委员会主任刘拉因（音译）及其他九名嫌疑犯的公开审判的最新进展之一，是已故湖北省主席杨永泰将军的家属提起损害赔偿诉讼。杨将军于去年10月28日遇刺身亡。

该损害赔偿诉讼由杨家律师谢兴基（音译）先生于今日，即审判的第二天提起，要求刘拉因、郑海超（音译）、龚柏舟、雅索·平勇（音译）、杨孝明（音译）和范惠书（音译）赔偿218,560美元。起诉书指控这些人直接或间接对已故杨将军之死负责。

今日的审判上午在座无虚席的法庭开庭。第一次审判于上周六举行。
否认所有指控

如同第一次审判一样，被告今天同样断然否认起诉书中针对他们的所有指控。这些否认伴随着闪烁其词的回答。

佐平勇（音译），审判中的九名嫌疑犯之一，今天完全撤回了此前在南京调查警察局、武汉国民党中央党部以及武昌地方法院所作的供词。

刘拉因通过宣读一份千字声明来回答武昌地方法院检察官提出的指控，阐述了七条理由以辩护其清白。

THE SHANGHAI SUNDAY TIMES, MAY 16, 1937

Trial Of Mr. Liu Lu-ying
Begins At Hankow

7,000 Word Indictment Alleges He Plotted For
Assassination Of Leaders; Was Arrested In
Settlement Here As Leaving His Hotel

HANKOW, May 15. The open trial of Mr. Liu Lu-ying, suspended member of the Central Executive Committee of the Kuomintang, began in the Wuchang First District Court this morning.

In the indictment—a 7,000-word document—Mr. Liu is charged with having:

Instigated the assassination of General Yang Yung-tai, Governor of Hupeh, last year.

Engineered a plot to assassinate, among others, General Chiang Kai-shek, the Premier; General Chang Chun, former Foreign Minister; General Chiang Tso-pin, Minister of the Interior; and General Yu Fei-peng, Minister of Communications.

Committed various offences against public peace and order.

Author Of Slip

The indictment alleges that Liu Lu-ying was the author of a slip of paper found in the possession of Yang Yung-tai's murderers containing instructions for the assassination.

The names of ten other persons are included in the indictment, of whom six are at large and four in custody at Wuchang.

Two of the accused have already been sentenced to death for the murder of General Yang, including the man alleged to have been the actual murderer.

Mr. Liu, who is a graduate of the University of California, was arrested in Shanghai in February as he was emerging from a hotel in the International Settlement in the early hours of the morning.

Later he was taken to Wuchang for trial after extradition proceedings.

Wrote Manifestoes

Mr. Liu was a member of the Cantonese faction of the Kuomintang. He was the author of several manifestoes issued by the South-West authorities during last year's abortive movement against Nanking.

During the Third Plenary Session of the Central Executive Committee in February he visited the capital, but a few days later left hurriedly for Shanghai.—Reuter.

（手写批注：16/5）

刘芦英先生审判
在汉口开始

七千字起诉书指控其策划
暗杀领导人；在本租界
离开旅馆时被捕

汉口，5月15日。国民党中央执行委员会停职成员刘芦英先生的公开审判，今天上午在武昌第一地方法院开始。

在一份长达七千字的起诉书中，刘先生被控：

煽动暗杀去年湖北省主席杨永泰将军。

策划暗杀包括行政院院长蒋介石将军、前外交部长张群将军、内政部长蒋作宾将军和交通部长余飞鹏（音译）将军在内的多人。

犯下各种危害公共和平与秩序的罪行。

纸条作者

起诉书指控刘芦英是一张在杨永泰将军凶手身上发现的纸条的作者，该纸条包含暗杀指令。

起诉书还包括其他十人的名字，其中六人在逃，四人在武昌被拘留。

两名被告已因谋杀杨永泰将军被判死刑，其中包括据称是实际凶手的人。

刘先生毕业于加州大学，今年二月在上海国际租界一家酒店凌晨外出时被捕。

随后经过引渡程序，他被带往武昌受审。

撰写宣言

刘先生是国民党粤系成员。他是去年西南当局反对南京的运动失败期间发布的几份宣言的作者。

在二月的中央执行委员会第三届全体会议上，他曾访问首都，但几天后匆忙前往上海。—路透社。

（手写批注：16/5）

The Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury, Saturday, May 15, 1937

Liu Trial Opens
Before Tribunal

Relatives Of Assassin
Victim File Claim
For $300,000

Pressing for conviction and severe punishment of Mr. Liu Lu-ying, suspended member of the Central Executive Committee of the Kuomintang, accused of having instigated the murder of General Tang Tung-lai, survivors of the late chairman of the Hupeh provincial government have submitted a petition to the Wuchang District Court and filed a civil claim of $300,000 damages.

Facing charges of instigating the assassination, plotting the murder of Generals Chang Hsueh-liang, Chiang Tao-ping, and Ta Hsi-tung, and alleged offenses against public peace and order, Mr. Liu was facing the Wuchang tribunal today together with four others, including two arrested immediately following the assassination in Hankow last November.

Passes Barred

Although the trial was open to the public, only persons armed with special passes issued by the tribunal were admitted into the courtroom. In securing the passes, the applicants were required to register full details about themselves and agree to subject to search when they entered the courtroom. The precautions were taken because of rumors that Mr. Liu's alleged assassin group, known as the China Youth Special Service Corps as pointed out in the indictment, was to stage some disturbances in the court.

The trial, which is expected to be protracted, will be continued on Monday although judgment is expected to be delayed for several weeks in view of the political significance of the case. In event of a conviction, Mr. Liu is entitled to file an appeal to the Hupeh High Court and then the Supreme Court in Nanking.

18 Released

As the five were facing court today, 18 other suspects, found to be innocent by the procurate after a thorough investigation lasting several months, have been released. They regained their freedom yesterday.

Mr. Liu was arrested in Shanghai last February when he returned to the city from Nanking. He was ordered handed over to the Wuchang authorities by the First Special District Court.
