The Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury, Thursday, February 25, 1937.
19402
07801

Liu To Get
South Help
In Trouble

Assassinations Said
Instigated By CEC
Member

PLOT NETWORK
RECEIVES AIRING

Garrison Police Kept
Watch On Liu Home;
Evidence Gathered

Formal charges of allegedly being the instigator of the assassinations of General Yang Yung-tai in Hankow and Mr. Tang Yu-jen in Shanghai will be preferred against Mr. Liu Lu-yu, member of the Central Executive Committee of the Kuomintang, by Nanking authorities if and when they win the extradition proceedings in the First Special District Court, it is learned today.

Arrested in front of the Yangtze Hotel, Yunnan Road, yesterday morning, Mr. Liu is being detained at the Chengtu Road Station and will face the court again Monday morning when the Shanghai-Woosung Garrison Commander's Headquarters will make a formal application for his extradition. Mr. Liu was transferred from Louza Station to Chengtu Road Station yesterday afternoon in order he may be given the special treatment of a private cell with steam heating. He has also changed his foreign dress into a Chinese long gown and allowed to eat the food brought in by his wife. The special treatment was accorded him in accordance with a ruling of the First Special District Court.

Semi-official circles in Nanking declare that Mr. Liu's arrest was given by the fact that he was in custody for being implicated in the murder of General Yang Yung-tai, the late chairman of the Hopei provincial government, in Hankow last November. Mr. Liu it is further alleged, is closely connected with the assassination of Mr. Tang Yu-jen, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs, in Route Garden House on Christmas Day, 1936. His alleged connection in the latter case, however, has not been proved.

Mr. Liu, the Nanking semi-official circle charge, organized an allegedly reactionary group known as the "Revolutionary Allied Corps" with himself as the leader. Under the alleged organization is a "Chinese Youth Special Service Division" which is a secret service branch in Nanking, Shanghai, Hankow, Wuchang, Kiukiang, Chinkiang, Anhwei, Kiangsi, Hupeh, Shanghai and Nanking. Mr. Liu, it is further alleged, stationed "communication agents" with monthly expenses of $100. The agents were most active in Nanking and Hankow, it is said. When General Yang was assassinated in Hankow last November when he was returning to Wuchang from a luncheon in the American Consulate-General, the assassin, Chen Hsi-chun, was immediately arrested. Two others, Chang Fu-sheng and Yang Chi-hsin, were later taken into custody. They implicated one Yang Teh-chien, who, according to their statements, was entrusted by Mr. Liu to direct the plot to murder General Yang and other higher political and military figures in the Wuhan area.

Police investigating the case finally obtained the Shanghai address of Yang. A raid was carried out but Yang has already escaped. Officers kept a watch on the house and trapped one Hsiao Ju-shu, who arrived from Hongkong. Hsiao is said to have confessed that he was sent by the leader of the "Chinese Youth Special Service Division" to recall Yang to Hongkong. Hsiao said that he met the leader in Mr. Liu's Sing-pore residence. He also declared that Mr. Liu was behind the plot.

To confirm statements

The Nanking authorities in charge of the case are preparing to compile all of the statements given by the arrested men and all available evidence now that Mr. Liu has been taken into custody.

The Shanghai Evening Post this morning also learned that the order for Mr. Liu's arrest was sent to the Lunghwa Headquarters by the Military Affairs Commission, of which General Chiang Kai-shek is the chairman.

Kwangsi Watched

The reaction of the Kwangsi leaders, who are known to be closely connected with Mr. Liu, is being watched. Generals Li Tsung-jen and Pai Chung-hsi were scheduled to assume the new posts as commander-in-chief and vice-commander-in-chief of the Fifth Route Army, the new title of their crack Fourth Army Corps, on March 1. Mr. Huang Shu-hsu, chairman of the Kwangsi provincial government, arrived from Nanking today after attending the C.E.C. session but he could not be approached for a statement this morning.

It is reliably learned, however, that the Kwangsi leaders have been informed of Mr. Liu's arrest and telegrams are expected from them this afternoon guaranteeing the innocence of the arrested C.E.C. member. Mr. Liu, it is said, was official delegate of the Kwangsi leaders to the C.E.C. session.

A veteran member of the Kuomintang, Mr. Liu, educated in California, was a close follower of the late Mr. Hu Han-min. He arrived from Hongkong recently and proceeded to Nanking. He never attended the C.E.C. sessions. When in court yesterday morning, Mr. Liu vigorously denied the charges.

It is learned that during his brief stay in Nanking, Mr. Liu interviewed high officials of the Kuomintang, including Messrs. Chen Ko-fu and Chen Li-fu. They are claimed to have given Mr. Liu assurances of general safety despite his activities in the Kwangsi area. It is also understood that Mr. Liu, before leaving Nanking, had met General Chiang Kai-shek once in the capital city.

S.I.
2/25

pages.zh:
《上海晚邮报与信使报》，1937年2月25日，星期四。
19402
07801

刘氏在困境中
获得南方援助

据称暗杀案
由中执委成员
煽动

阴谋网络
被公开披露

戍卫警察监视
刘宅；收集证据

据悉，如果南京当局在第一特区地方法院的引渡程序中获胜，届时将对国民党中央执行委员会委员刘芦英（Liu Lu-yu，音译）先生正式提出指控，指称其煽动了在汉口暗杀杨永泰（Yang Yung-tai）将军以及在上海暗杀唐有壬（Tang Yu-jen）先生的案件。

刘先生于昨晨在云南路扬子饭店门前被捕，目前被拘押在成都路捕房，并将于周一上午再次出庭，届时上海吴淞戍卫司令总部将正式申请将其引渡。刘先生于昨日下午从老闸捕房转移至成都路捕房，以便他能享受单人牢房及蒸汽供暖的特殊待遇。他还换下了西装，改穿中式长袍，并被允许食用其妻子送来的食物。根据第一特区地方法院的裁决，给予了他这种特殊待遇。

南京半官方人士宣称，刘先生被捕是因为他被牵连进去年11月在汉口谋杀前河北省政府主席杨永泰将军一案而在押。此外，据称刘先生与1936年圣诞节在花园饭店（Route Garden House，即今花园饭店前身或相关地点，当时常指华懋饭店等，此处Route Garden House可能指Garden Road的住所或饭店，史实唐有壬死于霞飞路寓所，但原文如此，译为花园路寓所或花园饭店？Route通常指路。Garden House可能是指位于花园路的住宅。译为：花园路寓所）暗杀外交部次长唐有壬先生一案有密切关联。不过，他在后一案中的所谓关联尚未得到证实。

南京半官方圈子指控，刘先生组织了一个所谓的反动团体，名为“革命同盟军”（Revolutionary Allied Corps），并自任首领。在该所谓组织之下设有一个“中国青年特别服务处”（Chinese Youth Special Service Division），这是南京、上海、汉口、武昌、九江、镇江、安徽、江西、湖北、上海和南京（原文重复上海和南京）的一个秘密情报分支机构。据进一步指控，刘先生派驻了“联络代理人”，每月费用为100美元。据说这些代理人在南京和汉口最为活跃。去年11月，杨永泰将军在汉口从美国总领事馆午餐返回武昌途中遇刺，刺客陈希春（Chen Hsi-chun，音译）立即被捕。另外两人，张福生（Chang Fu-sheng，音译）和杨吉新（Yang Chi-hsin，音译），后来也被拘留。他们供出了一名杨德建（Yang Teh-chien，音译），据他们的陈述，此人受刘先生委托，指挥谋杀杨将军及武汉地区其他高级政治和军事人物的阴谋。

调查此案的警察最终获得了杨在上海的住址。警方进行了突击搜查，但杨已经逃脱。警官们监视了该住所，并诱捕了一名从香港抵达的萧汝书（Hsiao Ju-shu，音译）。据说萧供认，他是受“中国青年特别服务处”头目派遣，将杨召回香港。萧称，他在刘先生的新加坡寓所会见了该头目。他还声称刘先生是幕后主使。

以证实供词

负责此案的南京当局正准备汇编所有被捕人员的供词以及现有的一切证据，因为刘先生已被收押。

《上海晚邮报》今晨还获悉，逮捕刘先生的命令是由军事委员会发往龙华总部的，该委员会由蒋介石将军担任主席。

监视广西方面

人们正在关注与刘先生关系密切的广西领导人的反应。李宗仁将军和白崇禧将军定于3月1日就任第五路军总司令和副总司令的新职，这是他们精锐的第四军团的新番号。广西省政府主席黄旭初（Huang Shu-hsu，音译）先生在参加完中央执行委员会会议后，今天从南京抵达，但今早未能联系到他发表声明。

然而，据可靠消息获悉，广西领导人已被告知刘先生被捕的消息，预计今天下午会收到他们发来的电报，保证这位被捕的中执委委员是无辜的。据说，刘先生是广西领导人出席中央执行委员会会议的正式代表。

刘先生是国民党资深党员，曾在加利福尼亚受教育，是已故胡汉民先生的亲密追随者。他最近从香港抵达，并前往南京。他从未参加过中央执行委员会会议。昨天上午在法庭上，刘先生强烈否认了各项指控。

据悉，在南京短暂停留期间，刘先生会见了国民党高官，包括陈果夫和陈立夫先生。据称，尽管他在广西地区的活动，他们仍向刘先生保证了总体安全。另据了解，刘先生在离开南京前，曾在首都见过蒋介石将军一次。

THE CHINA PRESS, THURSDAY, FEBRUARY 25, 1987

Transfer Of
Liu To Come
Before Court
Here Monday

Ex-Party Official Nabbed Here, Linked To Yang-Tang Murders
FORMERLY HEADED PUBLICITY OFFICE
Garrison Representative, S.M. Police Make Arrest

Formal request for the extradition of Mr. Liu Lu-ying, former Chairman of the Publicity Department of the Central Executive Committee of the Kuomintang, arrested in Shanghai yesterday on suspicion of having been concerned in two assassinations of prominent Chinese officials, is expected to be made before the First Special District Court next Monday morning, The China Press learned last night.

Mr. Liu was arrested about 1:30 a.m. yesterday as he walked out of the Yangtze Hotel on Yuenan Road. The arrest was made by detectives of the Shanghai and Woosung Garrison Headquarters operating with the Shanghai Municipal Police. He was brought before the court about 10 a.m.

Garrison officials present informed the tribunal that the former C.E.C. member was wanted in connection with the slaying of General Yang Yung-tai, Chairman of the Provincial Government of Hupeh, last November, and the assassination in Shanghai on Christmas Day, 1936, of Mr. Tang Yu-jen, then Vice-Minister of Foreign Affairs.

No Time To Get Warrant
The spokesman for the Garrison, himself a detective and chief of a group which had trailed Mr. Liu since late Monday night, informed the court that under circumstances had been so urgent that there had been no time to obtain a warrant of arrest beforehand and his men had no choice but go into such a place. It was high time to arrest him.

When the officers came out of the Yangtze Hotel they immediately searched him and his room but found nothing. It was learned later that Mr. Liu gave the S.M.P. the address of the C.E.C. The detective explained that he was certain the authorities at Nanking would make formal request for extradition in a few days, possibly by Monday, and the case was remanded until then.

Mr. Paul Y. Ru, Assistant Municipal Advocate for the S.M.P., informed the court that Mr. Liu could not be handed over without a prima facie case having been established. He added that thus far, no such case had been established and reminded the court that the man had been picked up without a warrant. Speaking on his own behalf, Mr. Liu branded the suspicions against him as unfounded. He stated that he had always been a supporter of the principles of Dr. Sun Yat-sen and had never engaged in subversive activities against the state. He continued that if he had been engaged in such activities, it was hardly likely that he would have gone to Nanking from Hongkong to attend the C.E.C. plenary conference.

Mr. Liu, who was just relieved of his post as chief of the Central Publicity Bureau during the recent Government sessions in Nanking, is a graduate of the University of California. He was at one time director of the Compilations Committee of the Central Government. That was when Hu Han-min was active in the Government.

Arrived 10 Days Ago
He arrived in Shanghai from Hongkong about 10 days ago and then went to Nanking apparently to attend the C.E.C. sessions. It was reported yesterday that although in Nanking, he did not attend, but complained of a sore throat and returned to Shanghai four days ago. He was trailed by detectives from the day after his return. He was a member of the C.E.C. since 1932 and was reappointed to the Publicity Committee in January, 1936. He spent most of his time, however, in Canton, Nanning and Hongkong. Mr. Shao Lih-tzu was appointed his successor.

Asked to sign a statement of what he told the court, Mr. Liu refused, saying that he would first have to read the record of his remarks before he would put his signature to it. His attorney, Mr. Wong Shan-an, asked for his client's immediate release but this was not granted. Mrs. Liu, who was arrested with her husband, has been released.

刘氏移交
将于周一
在此出庭

前党派官员在此被捕，与杨-唐谋杀案有关
曾任宣传部部长
戍卫代表与工部局警务处实施逮捕

《大美晚报》昨晚获悉，针对前国民党中央执行委员会宣传部部长刘芦英（Liu Lu-ying，音译）先生的正式引渡请求，预计将于下周一上午在第一特区地方法院提出。刘先生昨日在上海因涉嫌参与两起中国高官暗杀案而被捕。

刘先生于昨日凌晨1时30分左右走出云南路扬子饭店时被捕。此次逮捕由上海吴淞戍卫总部侦探与上海公共租界工部局警务处合作执行。他于上午10时左右被带上法庭。

在场的戍卫官员告知法庭，这位前中执委委员因涉及去年11月湖北省政府主席杨永泰将军被杀案，以及1936年圣诞节在上海发生的时任外交部次长唐有壬先生暗杀案而受到通缉。

无暇获取逮捕令

戍卫方面发言人本身也是一名侦探，他是自上周深夜起一直跟踪刘先生的小组负责人。他告知法庭，由于情况紧急，事先没有时间获取逮捕令，他的人别无选择，只能进入该场所。逮捕他已是刻不容缓。

当警官们从扬子饭店出来时，他们立即搜查了他和他的房间，但一无所获。后来得知，刘先生向工部局警务处提供了中央执行委员会的地址。该侦探解释说，他确信南京当局将在几天内，可能在周一，提出正式的引渡请求，案件因此延期至那时审理。

工部局警务处助理检察官鲁保罗（Paul Y. Ru，音译）先生告知法庭，在未建立初步案件（prima facie case）的情况下，不能移交刘先生。他补充说，到目前为止，尚未建立这样的案件，并提醒法庭，此人是在没有逮捕令的情况下被抓捕的。刘先生为自己辩护，称对他的怀疑毫无根据。他表示，自己一直是孙中山博士原则的支持者，从未从事过反对国家的颠覆活动。他接着说，如果他参与了此类活动，他就不太可能从香港前往南京参加中央执行委员会全体会议。

刘先生刚刚在南京最近的政府会议期间被解除中央宣传部部长职务，他是加利福尼亚大学的毕业生。他曾任中央政府编译委员会主任委员。那是在胡汉民在政府中活跃时期。

十天前抵达

他大约10天前从香港抵达上海，然后前往南京，显然是为了参加中央执行委员会会议。昨日有报道称，尽管身在南京，他并未参会，而是抱怨喉咙痛，并于四天前返回上海。从他返回的第二天起，他就被侦探跟踪。他自1932年起担任中央执行委员会委员，并于1936年1月被重新任命为宣传委员会委员。然而，他大部分时间 spent 在广州、南宁和香港。邵力子先生被任命为他的继任者。

当被要求签署一份他在法庭上所述内容的陈述书时，刘先生拒绝了，他说他必须先阅读他的发言记录，然后才会签名。他的律师王山安（Wong Shan-an，音译）先生要求立即释放其当事人，但未获批准。与丈夫一同被捕的刘太太已获释。

THE SHANGHAI TIMES, THURSDAY, FEBRUARY 25, 1937

Member Of C.E.C. Held As
Assassination Suspect

Arrested On Secret Instructions From Nanking On
Suspicion Of Part In Two Killings; S.M.P.
Oppose Extradition—Little Evidence

Alleged to have been concerned in the assassinations of General Yang Yoong-tai, Governor of Hupeh, in Hankow last November, and the killing of Tang Yu-jen, former Vice-Minister of Foreign Affairs, in the French Concession on Christmas Day, 1935, Mr. Liu Loo-ying, 44, member of the Central Executive Committee of the Kuomintang, was brought up on a writ of detention before Judge Feng in the First Special District Court yesterday morning.

Mr. Liu was arrested by officers of the Shanghai-Woosung Garrison Commissioner's Headquarters, at about 1.30 yesterday morning when he stepped out of the Yangtze Hotel on Yunnan Road. His arrest and the detention of his wife, who was with him, looked very much like a kidnapping. When Mr. and Mrs. Liu walked out of the hotel and attempted to step into a waiting motor car, six officers of the Shanghai-Woosung Garrison produced pistols and ordered Mr. Liu to step into their motor car. He, however, yelled for a policeman, who was standing nearby, resulting in the whole party proceeding to the Louza Police Station.

There the Chinese officers requested the Settlement police to arrest Mr. Liu. As the Chinese officers failed to produce a dispatch warrant, doubt arose whether there was any right to arrest the men. Later it was ascertained that a secret order had been sent on February 23, for Liu arrest. General Yang Liu head of the Nantao Police Bureau, was communicated with and confirmed this.

Extradition Opposed
When Liu was brought before Judge Feng yesterday morning a representative of the Shanghai-Woosung Garrison Commissioner made an application for him to be handed over. Assistant Municipal Advocate Paul Y. Ru, who had first outlined the details of the arrest, opposed the request for extradition, pointing out first, there was little or no evidence produced against Liu and, secondly, if even there were evidence that Liu was connected in some way with the two political assassinations, it was for the civil court to apply for his extradition and not for the military authorities.

In addressing the judge, Liu protested against his detention without any proof being produced that he was concerned in two murders. Judge Feng did not grant the request for extradition yesterday, but remanded Liu's hearing until next Monday. In the meantime Liu will be detained at the Louza Police Station. The prisoner complained about his treatment at the police station and the judge made a request that special treatment be accorded to him.

In both cases suspects have been arrested. Soon after the shot had been fired which killed General Yang in Hankow, it will be recalled, a Cantonese youth armed with a pistol was arrested and he readily confessed to the crime. His detailed confession has never been made public.

Two suspects have been arrested here in connection with the murder of Mr. Tang Yu-jen, who was shot dead in front of his French Concession residence. They are being detained by the Second Special District Court. Several hearings have been held. At first they confessed to the crime explaining that they had murdered Mr. Tang for patriotic reasons because the late Vice-Foreign Minister was pro-Japanese. At the latest hearing, however, they repudiated their confessions. On no occasion did they mention the instigator of the crime.

Publicity Chief
Mr. Liu, who has just been relieved of his post as chief of the Central Publicity Bureau, is a graduate of the University of California and was a director of the Compilations Committee under the late Hu Han-min. He is also stated as having played a prominent part in the abortive Kwangtung-Kwangsi rebellion last summer.

The reaction of Generals Li Tsung-jen and Pai Chung-hsi, Kwangsi military leaders, who on Tuesday were appointed commander and vice-commander of the Fifth Route Army, to Mr. Liu's arrest, is being watched.

Mr. Liu arrived from Hongkong about 10 days ago, but remained in Shanghai until a week ago. He did not attend the Third Plenary Session saying that he was suffering from throat trouble. He returned to Shanghai on Sunday, the day he was relieved of the post of Director of the Central Publicity Department of the Central Kuomintang Mr. Chen Kung-po, former Minister of Industry, was appointed as his successor.

Native Of Kiangsi
A native of Yung-feng, Kiangsi. Mr. Liu was born in 1888. After attending schools in his native place and Shanghai, he went abroad to the United States where he obtained the degree of Bachelor of Science at the University of California. Since his return to China he taught in various universities and, at the same time, secretly worked for the Kuomintang. He held the first official post as director of the Compilation Bureau of the Legislative Yuan between 1926 and 1931 when Mr. Hu Han-min was serving as president of the law-making body. During that period he concurrently held the post as director of the Central Publicity Department.

In 1932, he was appointed vice-president of the Examination Yuan but he declined the post. He has been a member of the C. E. C. since 1929. (reappointed to the Publicity Department in January, 1935. Mr. Liu never assumed his post, spending most of his time in Chiang Siang and Nanking.

《字林西报》，1937年2月25日，星期四

中委被扣为刺杀嫌疑犯

奉南京密令以涉嫌参与两起谋杀案被捕；工部局警务处反对引渡——证据寥寥

现年44岁的国民党中央执行委员刘芦英（Liu Loo-ying，音译）先生，被指控卷入去年11月在汉口发生的湖北省主席杨永泰将军遇刺案，以及1935年圣诞节在法租界发生的前外交部次长唐有壬遇害案。昨日上午，他持拘留令在第一特区地方法院冯法官面前受审。

昨日凌晨约1时30分，当刘先生从云南路的扬子饭店走出时，被上海吴淞警备司令部的人员逮捕。他和同行的妻子被拘押，其情形极似绑架。当刘氏夫妇走出饭店并试图进入一辆等候的汽车时，六名上海吴淞警备司令部军官拔出手枪，命令刘先生进入他们的汽车。然而，他向附近站立的一名警察大声呼救，导致众人一同前往老闸捕房。

在那里，中国军官要求租界警方逮捕刘先生。由于中国军官未能出示逮捕令，人们对其是否有权逮捕此人产生了怀疑。后经查实，2月23日曾发出逮捕刘的秘密命令。此事已与南市警察局局长杨虎将军联系并得到证实。

反对引渡
昨日上午刘先生被带上法庭时，上海吴淞警备司令部代表申请将其移交。助理市检察官陆文权（Paul Y. Ru，音译）首先概述了逮捕细节，随后反对引渡请求。他指出：第一，针对刘先生的证据很少或根本没有；第二，即使有证据表明刘先生与这两起政治暗杀案有某种牵连，也应由民事法院申请引渡，而非由军事当局提出。

刘先生在对法官陈述时，抗议在没有任何证据证明他参与两起谋杀案的情况下将其拘留。冯法官昨日未批准引渡请求，而是将刘先生的听证会延期至下周一。在此期间，刘先生将被羁押于老闸捕房。囚犯抱怨其在捕房受到的待遇，法官随即要求给予其特殊待遇。

在这两起案件中，均有嫌疑人被捕。众所周知，在汉口枪杀杨将军的枪声响起后不久，一名持手枪的广东青年被捕，并爽快认罪。但其详细供词从未公开。

在上海，与唐有壬先生谋杀案有关的两名嫌疑人已被捕，唐先生是在其法租界寓所前被枪杀的。他们正由第二特区地方法院羁押。已举行多次听证。起初他们承认犯罪，解释说出于爱国理由杀害唐先生，因为这位已故外交部次长亲日。然而在最近的听证会上，他们推翻了之前的供词。他们在任何场合均未提及犯罪的指使者。

宣传主管
刘先生刚刚卸任中央宣传部部长一职，他是加州大学毕业生，曾任已故胡汉民先生领导下的编纂委员会主任。据称，他在去年夏天流产的两广叛乱中也发挥了重要作用。

广西军事领袖李宗仁和白崇禧将军对刘先生被捕的反应正受到关注，二人于周二被任命为第五路军总指挥和副总指挥。

刘先生约十天前从香港抵达，但在上海停留至一周前。他以患有喉疾为由未出席三中全会。上周日他返回上海，就在当天，他被免去国民党中央宣传部部长职务，前实业部部长陈公博先生被任命为其继任者。

江西籍人士
刘先生是江西永丰人，生于1888年。在家乡和上海求学后，他赴美留学，在加州大学获得理学学士学位。回国后，他在多所大学任教，同时秘密为国民党工作。1926年至1931年间，在胡汉民先生担任立法机构负责人期间，他担任立法院编译局局长的首个官职。在此期间，他还兼任中央宣传部部长。

1932年，他被任命为考试院副院长，但他拒绝了该职位。自1929年以来，他一直是中央执行委员会委员。（1935年1月重新调任宣传部。刘先生从未就职，大部分时间待在蒋乡（Chiang Siang，音译）和南京。

Kwangsi military leaders who yes-
day were appointed commander
and vice-commander of the 5th
Route Army, to the arrest of Mr.
Liu is being closely watched in
view of their close connection.
During the Kwangtung and
Kwangsi troubles, Mr. Liu played
a prominent role in Canton and
later in Nanning, directing the
political side of the agitation
against Nanking.

From Hongkong
Mr. Lu arrived from Hongkong
about 10 days ago. Although the
C.E.C. plenary session opened on
February 15, he remained in
Shanghai until a week ago. He
did not attend the sessions, saying
he was suffering from throat
trouble. He returned to Shang-
hai on Sunday, the very day on
which he was relieved of his post
as the director of the Central
Publicity Department of the Cen-
tral Kuomintang, because "he
failed to attend office for a long
time." Mr. Shao Lih-tsz, formerly
chairman of the Shensi provincial
government, was appointed his
successor.
A native of Yungfeng, Kiangsi.
Mr. Liu was born in 1895. After
attending schools in his native
place and Shanghai, he went
abroad to the United States where
he obtained the degree of Bachelor
of Science at the University of
California. Since his return to
China, he taught in various uni-
versities and, at the same time,
secretly worked for the Kuomin-
tang. He held the first official
post as director of the Compila-
tion Bureau of the Legislative
Yuan between 1928 and 1931 when
Mr. Hu Han-min was serving as
president of the law-making body.
During the period he concurrent-
ly held the post as director of the
Central Publicity Department.
In 1932, he was appointed vice-
president of the Examination Yuan
but he declined the post. He is
member of the C. E. C. since 1929.
Reappointed to the Publicity De-
partment in January, 1936, Mr. Liu
never assumed his post, spending
most of his time in Canton, Nan-
ning and Hongkong.

《上海晚邮报与水星报》，1937年2月24日，星期三 19494

著名中委
在此因涉
谋杀案

代表在晨间突袭
扬子饭店时被俘

刘芦英，胡汉民亲信，加州大学毕业生，
因涉嫌杨永泰、唐有壬死亡案被捕

吴淞警备司令部寻求监管权

据称在南京的秘密通讯中被指控卷入去年11月
湖北省主席杨永泰将军谋杀案以及1935年圣诞
节在上海发生的唐有壬谋杀案，国民党中
央执行委员、已故胡汉民的追随者刘芦英先
生，今晨持拘留令在第一特区地方法院冯法
官面前受审。

今晨由租界警方逮捕，此前上海吴淞警备司
令部的侦探进行了看似可疑的绑架企图，刘
先生现被关押在老闸捕房，直至下周一再次
出庭。

遭遇侦探
刘先生声称四天前参加完南京中央执行委员
会第三届全体会议后返回上海，今晨约1时
30分与妻子一同走出云南路的扬子饭店。显
然一直跟踪他的吴淞警备司令部侦探拔出手
枪，试图强行将他塞进他们的汽车。刘先生
没有顺从他们“带有威胁性”的要求，而是大
声呼救。一名值班的中国巡捕（C.P.C.）闻
声跑来，结果是刘先生最终被带往老闸捕
房。吴淞警备司令部的侦探在租界警方到达
后，请求协助逮捕刘先生。由于他们未出示
任何逮捕刘先生的公文，上海又出现了一起
奇特的警务状况。人们对是否存在公文存有
疑虑。后获悉，2月22日从南京发来一道秘
密命令，要求拘留刘先生。最终联系上了杨
虎将军，据称该秘密命令确实存在。高级租
界当局依据拘留令将刘先生移交给中国当
局，并将其移交给中国当局的问题留给第一
特区地方法院裁决。

欺诈性绑架者
刘先生今晨被带上法庭时宣称，他认为昨晚
侦探试图绑架他，这就是他呼救的原因。
“他们声称我卷入两起谋杀案。为什么不拿
出证据？那样我对被捕和拘留就没有异议
了。”

归国留学生
刘先生最近在南京政府会议期间刚刚卸任中
央宣传部部长一职，他是加州大学毕业生，
曾在胡汉民在中央政府掌权时期担任胡手下
的编纂委员会主任。据称，这位前宣传主管
还积极参与了去年夏天流产的两广叛乱。
今晨他向法官提及自己与政府的关系，声称
自己是知名官员，没有理由隐瞒任何事情。

请求自由
刘先生称自己在捕房受到恶劣待遇，请求准
予保释。此时，助理市检察官陆文权跳起
来，指着刘先生剪裁得体的衣服说：
“看看他的领带和衣领。大多数囚犯是不允
许戴领带的。”
刘先生说他整晚都没能睡觉，还要了香烟。
法官随即要求捕房给予刘先生良好待遇。

萧颂琴离沪
去拜访蒋介石
拒绝签字
当被要求在法庭陈述记录上签字时，刘先生
表示必须先阅读他的发言记录，然后才会签
字。
刘先生的妻子李华氏（Lip Hwa-sz，音译），
最初与他一同被捕，现已获释，今晨在法庭
与其丈夫的律师王周安（Wong Chou-an，音
译）先生商议。
鉴于关系密切，广西军事领袖李宗仁和白崇
禧将军（二人于昨日被任命为第五路军总指
挥和副总指挥）对刘先生被捕的反应正受到
密切关注。
在两广事变期间，刘先生在广州及后来的南
宁发挥了重要作用，指导了反对南京的政治
煽动活动。

来自香港
刘先生约十天前从香港抵达。虽然中委全体
会议于2月15日开幕，但他留在上海直到一
周前。他以患有喉疾为由未出席会议。上周
日他返回上海，就在当天，他因“长期未到
职”而被免去国民党中央宣传部部长职务。
前陕西省政府主席邵力子先生被任命为其继
任者。
刘先生是江西永丰人，生于1895年。在家乡
和上海求学后，他赴美留学，在加州大学获
得理学学士学位。回国后，他在多所大学任
教，同时秘密为国民党工作。1928年至1931
年间，在胡汉民先生担任立法机构负责人期
间，他担任立法院编译局局长的首个官职。
在此期间，他还兼任中央宣传部部长。
1932年，他被任命为考试院副院长，但他拒
绝了该职位。自1929年以来，他一直是中央
执行委员会委员。1936年1月重新调任宣传
部，刘先生从未就职，大部分时间待在广州、
南宁和香港。

Lieu Loh-ying (劉蘆隱) age 44, married
Kiangsi.                                      D.S. Pitts
                                              D.S.I. Shih Hsu-chien

After finishing my education at the University of
California in 1923, I returned to China and worked as secretary
of the Publicity Department of the Nationalist Government under
Dr. Sun Yat-sen. Gradually I received promotion and in about
1928 assumed charge of this department. I remained chief until
about 1930.

After the late Mr. Hu Han-min returned from Europe
in 1928, he assumed the post of President of the Legislative
Yuan, and from that time I worked under him as a director of the
Compilations Committee.

In 1930 Hu Han-ming was detained by the Nationalist
Government and I took part in the discussions which eventually led
to his release and peace between Nanking and Canton.

After this I left my post as Chief of the Publicity
Department in Nanking, and went to Canton, where I spent my time
in promoting good relations between the opposing factions in an
effort to maintain internal peace in the party.

I have remained in Canton ever since, save for a number
of visits to Nanking on party affairs.

Recently I was invited by Nanking to attend to the
Plenary Session of the 5th Kuomintang Congress as a member of the
C.E.C. and I accepted. I attended various meetings connected
with the Session and left Nanking four days ago for Shanghai,
where until last night I resided with my wife's parents at 275
Rue Marceau.

Last night I went to the Yangtse Hotel to see certain
friends whose names I am not prepared to divulge, and was taken
pages.zh:
刘芦隐（Lieu Loh-ying），44岁，已婚
江西。                                      侦探警长 皮茨
                                              侦探督察 施旭坚（Shih Hsu-chien）

1923年在加州大学完成学业后，我回到中国，在孙中山博士领导下的国民政府宣传部担任秘书。逐渐获得晋升，约在1928年接管该部。我一直担任部长直至约1930年。

1928年胡汉民先生从欧洲回来后，就任立法院院长，从那时起，我在其手下担任编译委员会主任委员。

1930年胡汉民被国民政府扣押，我参与了最终导致其获释以及南京与广州之间和解的讨论。

此后，我辞去了在南京的宣传部长职务，前往广州，在那里致力于促进对立派系之间的良好关系，以维护党内的内部和平。

自此以后，我一直留在广州，除了因党务多次访问南京外。

最近，我应南京邀请，以中央执行委员会成员身份出席国民党第五届中央全会，我接受了邀请。我参加了与全会有关的各种会议，并于四天前离开南京前往上海，直到昨晚，我与岳父母居住在马浪路（Rue Marceau）275号。

昨晚我去扬子饭店看望某些朋友，其姓名我不便透露，随后被

pages.en:

later detained in the manner of which you are aware.
I am not a communist and am not connected in any way
anti-Blue Shirt activities. I have never taken part in any
political crimes, either directly or indirectly, and am
unable to understand the reason for my detention.

我不是共产党人，也与任何反蓝衣社活动没有任何关联。我从未直接或间接参与任何政治犯罪，也不明白我被拘留的原因。

REPORT
Date March 2, 1937.
Subject Real cause for the arrest of Liu Lu Ying, C.E.C. member.
Made by and Forwarded by Supt. Tan Shao-liang.
（批：Sent 8/3/37）
（批：Copy Mr. Alexander HBM Consul Gal）
（印：N3 - 3 MAR. 1937 SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE）
（批：J7206 C.P. hht Dc(CP)）
（批：J.7652 Cpt K F - A. G. stft Copies sent. Dhl. 313. 1）
Mr. Liu Lu Ying was put on board the S.S. "Kiang-an" about midnight March 1-2 under an escort of deputies of the Hankow Court and officers of the Police Bureau.
The decision to send him to Hankow was made by Mayor Wu on account of demands being made by various parties from Nanking for the handing over of the prisoner and Mayor Wu thought the proper cause to adopt was to allow the prisoner to be given a fair trial.
Information has been received from a fairly reliable source that the arrest of Mr. Liu Lu Ying was due to his reactionary activities against Nanking and to the formation of the so-called "The New Kuomintang of China" which aims at the overthrow of the present Central Kuomintang of Nanking. The murder of General Yang Yung Tai was simply put forward as a ground for his extradition. The suspicions against Liu became stronger because although he went to Nanking he failed to attend the conference but hurried back to Shanghai to continue his activities. Mr. Liu chose Shanghai as a base of operations because he knows that C.E.C. members will visit Shanghai after the conference was over.
It is alleged that Mr. Liu is responsible for the edition of many books distributed to various parts of China denouncing Chiang Kai Shek (see file relating to books which came from Tientsin through Thomas Cook & Sons). From correspondence intercepted by the postal censors, it appears that Mr. Liu had succeeded in inducing General Sung Cheh Yuen of Chili (Hopei) and General Han Fu Chu of Shantung to join the New Kuomintang of the South-West which is also being supported by Generals Li Chung Jen and Pei Chung Hsi of

主题：中央执行委员会委员刘芦隐被捕的真实原因。
由谭绍良警司撰写并呈报。
（批注：1937年3月8日发出）
（批注：抄送英国驻沪总领事亚历山大先生）
（印章：N3 - 1937年3月3日 上海公共租界工部局警务处）
（批注：J7206 C.P. hht Dc(CP)）
（批注：J.7652 Cpt K F - A. G. stft 副本已发送。Dhl. 313. 1）
刘芦隐先生于3月1日至2日午夜时分，在汉口法院法警及警察局警官的押送下，被送上“江安”轮（S.S. "Kiang-an"）。
将其送往汉口的决定是由吴市长作出的，原因是南京各方要求引渡该囚犯，吴市长认为采取适当理由是让该囚犯得到公正审判。
从相当可靠的消息来源获悉，刘芦隐先生被捕是由于其从事反对南京的反动活动，以及组建所谓的“中国新国民党”，旨在推翻南京现有的国民党中央。杨永泰将军被杀一事仅被作为引渡他的借口。对刘的怀疑加剧，是因为他虽然去了南京，却未参加会议，而是匆忙返回上海继续其活动。刘先生选择上海作为行动基地，因为他知道中央执行委员会成员在会议结束后会访问上海。
据称，刘先生负责编辑许多分发到中国各地的书籍，谴责蒋介石（参见关于通过通济隆旅行社从天津运来的书籍的档案）。从邮政检查员截获的信件来看，刘先生似乎成功诱使河北（直隶）的宋哲元将军和山东的韩复榘将军加入西南新国民党，该党还得到广西的李宗仁将军和白崇禧将军的支持，以及

Commissioner of Police.

The following is the statement of the facts
relating to the attempt made to arrest Lieu Loo Ying
(劉蘆隱) outside the Yangtsze Hotel (Yunnan and
Hankow Roads corner) at 1.30 a.m. on February 24, 1937 :

According to the staff of the Garrison Commissioners
Headquarters, a secret instruction was received direct
from the Nanking Military Council signed by General Chiang
Kai Shek on February 22, 1937, ordering the arrest of Lieu
Loo Ying for instigating the assassination of Tang Yu Jen,
Vice Minister of Foreign Affairs, in the French Concession in
1935 and Yang Yung Tai, Governor of Hupeh. This instruction
was received by the "Special Investigation Section (alleged
Blue Shirts) of the Headquarters without passing through
the Garrison Commander, General Yang Hu and without his
knowledge. (This was admitted by Inspector Yang Yun Kyi
of the Garrison at Louza Station ).

Information was apparently obtained that Lieu Loo
Ying would visit the Yangtsze Hotel and accordingly several
of the Lunghwa detectives were posted in the Yangtsze hotel
and vicinity on February 22, 1937. This is borne out by
a door boy of the hotel, named Li Yah Pao (李孝保) who
observed them during the evening of February 22, 1937,
when he was on duty. At about 10 p.m. on February 23, 1937,
the same detectives were again observed by the door boy
Li patrolling the hotel and vicinity. Just after 10 p.m.
Lieu and his wife arrived and proceeded to Room 630 of
the hotel, occupied by one Lee Ts Ching (李子清) who
according to Lieu Loo Ying is a Shanghai business man.
Lieu's chauffeur parked the car on Yunnan Road on the
West side facing Northwards and near the rear entrance of
the Yangtsze Hotel. The chauffeur then proceeded with his

以下是关于1937年2月24日凌晨1时30分在扬子饭店（云南路与汉口路转角）外试图逮捕刘芦隐（Lieu Loo Ying）一事的事实陈述：

据卫戍司令部职员称，1937年2月22日直接收到一份由蒋介石将军签署的南京军事委员会秘密指令，命令逮捕刘芦隐，罪名是煽动刺杀1935年在法租界的外交部次长唐有壬以及湖北省主席杨永泰。该指令由司令部“特别调查组”（据称为蓝衣社）接收，未经过卫戍司令杨虎将军，且杨将军对此不知情。（此点由老闸捕房卫戍督察杨云奇承认）。

显然已获得情报称刘芦隐将造访扬子饭店，因此1937年2月22日，几名龙华侦探被部署在扬子饭店及其附近。这一点得到了饭店一名名叫李孝保的门童的证实，他在1937年2月22日晚值班时观察到了他们。1937年2月23日晚10点左右，门童李再次观察到同样的侦探在饭店及周边巡逻。晚上10点刚过，刘及其妻子抵达，并前往饭店630房间，该房间由一位李子清（Lee Ts Ching）占用，据刘芦隐称，此人是一名上海商人。刘的司机将车停在云南路西侧，车头朝北，靠近扬子饭店的后门。随后司机前往

（批注：另见 F. 2546. D.R. 113。）

pages.en:
2
hallway of the hotel where he remained conversing
with other chauffeurs. No attempt was made to arrest Lieu
Loo Y.ng on his arrival. At 1.25 a.m. on February 24,
1937, Lieu Loo Ying and his wife came out of the hotel
lift and went out of the Yunnan Road door of the hotel
followed by the chauffeur. During Lieu's visit to the
hotel the Garrison Commissioner's detectives had succeeded
in parking their motor car Licence No. 6474 behind Lieu's car
to the South and facing Northwards. As Lieu Loo Ying then
walked along Yunnan Road in the roadway towards his car,
the Garrison detectives moved towards him and commenced
to surround him and his wife.
It is evident that they were not sure of the
man as they allowed him to approach his car apparently for
the purpose of identification. As he reached his car some
of the detectives showed Lieu their pistols (according to
Lieu) ordered him to keep quiet and enter the Garrison Car
No. 6474. Lieu, however, refused and succeeded in opening
the door of his own car. The detectives attempted to drag
him away but Lieu held on to the steering column of his
car while his wife came to his assistance and attempted
to push away the detectives. On observing this Lieu's
chauffeur ran back into the Yangtsze Hotel and shouted
for Police, saying that a number of men were fighting
with his master. The door boy Li ran out and observed a
large number of men including those whom he had previously
seen patrolling the hotel some attempting to drag Lieu Loo
Ying out of his car while others stood around. The offside
door of motor car No.6474 was open and other detectives
stood by the door in readiness to push Lieu Loo Ying into
their car. Li heard Lieu Loo Ying's wife asking why they
wanted her husband and one of the detectives stated
"after he has been to prison he will know why". Then
another detective in foreign clothes ordered the others
pages.zh:
2
饭店走廊，在那里与其他司机交谈。刘芦隐抵达时并未有人试图逮捕他。1937年2月24日凌晨1时25分，刘芦隐及其妻子走出饭店电梯，从饭店的云南路大门出去，司机紧随其后。在刘访问饭店期间，卫戍司令部的侦探已成功将其车牌号为6474的汽车停在刘的车后方南侧，车头朝北。当刘芦隐沿云南路车道走向他的汽车时，卫戍侦探向他移动并开始包围他和他的妻子。
显然他们并不确定此人身份，因为他们让他走近汽车，显然是为了确认身份。当他到达汽车旁时，一些侦探向刘出示了手枪（据刘称），命令他保持安静并进入卫戍部门的6474号汽车。然而，刘拒绝了，并成功打开了自己汽车的车门。侦探试图将他拖走，但刘紧紧抓住汽车的转向柱，而他的妻子前来协助，试图推开侦探。看到这一幕，刘的司机跑回扬子饭店大喊报警，称有一群人正在与他的主人打斗。门童李跑出来，观察到许多人，包括他之前看到在饭店巡逻的那些人，其中一些人试图将刘芦隐从车里拖出来，而其他人则站在周围。6474号汽车的右侧车门开着，其他侦探站在车门旁，准备将刘芦隐推进他们的车内。李听到刘芦隐的妻子询问为什么要抓她的丈夫，其中一名侦探回答说：“等他进了监狱就会知道为什么”。随后，另一名身穿便服的侦探命令其他人

pages.en:
3
not to talk toomuch but to pull Lieu away. The same detective
then shouted to the bystanders who commenced to gather, warning
them to stand back or they might be shot. This man put his
hands in his trousers pocket as if holding a pistol.
A shop assistant named Loh Yoong Ling (陸永林)
of the Yangtsze Cigarette & Exchange Shop next to the
Yunnan Road entrance of the hotel was engaged in fetching
the shop shutters, from the rear entrance of the hotel when the
attempt to pull Lieu Loo Ying into Garrison Car commenced.
He also observed three or four men attempting to drag Lieu from
his car but after a man in foreign dress had warned onlookers that
that he would shoot, he returned to his shop. He did not
actually see any pistols being on the other side of Lieu Loo
Ying's car.
By this time, however, C.P.C. 692 on special duty at
the Hotel responded to the chauffeur's alarm and came out of
the Yangtsze Hotel. The C.P.C. did not see any pistols
displayed. He approached asking what was the matter and
was told by the detectives to go away and not interfere
as it was none of his business. They further stated that
they were from the Garrison Commissioner's headquarters.
When the C.P.C. asked for their warrant cards they refused
saying that they had secret instructions. The C.P.C. then asked
the Garrison detectives whether they were kidnappers and this
question apparently calmed them down and they agreed to send
a man to Louza Station to report the matter. The arrival of
this man, Detective Tsze Yu Sing (朱又新), at 1.50 a.m.
on February 24, 1937, was the first intimation to the Station
of the Garrison Commissioner's headquarters intention to arrest
Lieu Loo Ying.
D.S. MacAdie and C.D.S.316 were called and the above
detective stated that members of the Garrison Commissioner's
Headquarters had arrested a male and female communist outside
the Yangtsze Hotel. On proceeding to the Yangtsze Hotel by
Station motor car, only two detectives named Sung Tsei (沈醉)

3
不要多说话，而是把刘拉走。同一名侦探随即向开始聚集的旁观者喊话，警告他们退后，否则可能会开枪。这个人把手伸进裤袋，好像拿着手枪一样。
位于饭店云南路入口旁的扬子香烟兑换店的一名店员陆永林（Loh Yoong Ling），在试图将刘芦隐拉入卫戍汽车的行为开始时，正从饭店后门去取店门板。他也观察到三四个人试图将刘从车里拖出来，但在一名穿便服的人警告旁观者他将开枪后，他回到了店里。他并没有实际看到刘芦隐汽车的另一侧有任何手枪。
然而，此时，在饭店执行特别任务的巡捕692号响应了司机的警报，从扬子饭店出来。该巡捕没有看到任何展示的手枪。他上前询问发生了什么事，侦探告诉他走开，不要干涉，因为这不关他的事。他们进一步声称他们来自卫戍司令部。当巡捕要求查看他们的证件时，他们拒绝了，称他们有秘密指令。随后巡捕问卫戍侦探他们是否是绑匪，这个问题显然让他们冷静下来，他们同意派人到老闸捕房报告此事。1937年2月24日凌晨1时50分，侦探朱又新（Tsze Yu Sing）的到达，是捕房首次得知卫戍司令部意图逮捕刘芦隐的消息。
麦阿迪副督察（D.S. MacAdie）和刑事侦缉高级警员316号（C.D.S.316）被召来，上述侦探陈述称，卫戍司令部成员在扬子饭店外逮捕了一男一女两名共产党分子。乘坐捕房警车前往扬子饭店时，只有两名分别名为沈醉（Sung Tsei）和程慕颐（Zung Mo Yi）的侦探被麦阿迪副督察和刑事侦缉高级警员316号观察到在扬子饭店外的车道上控制着刘芦隐及其妻子。巡捕692号站在一旁。
卫戍部门的6474号汽车已被用于运送侦探朱又新到捕房进行初步报告。

and Zung Mo Yi(程慕頤) were observed by D.S. MacAdie and
C.D.S. 316 on the roadway outside the Yangtsze Hotel holding
Lieu Loo Ying and his wife. C.P.C. 692 was standing by.
The Garrison motor car No.6474 had been used to convey detective
Tsze Yu Sing to the Station to make the initialreport.
All present were brought to the station. At 3 a.m. on
February 24, room 630 of the Yangtsze Hotel which Lieu Loo
Ying had visited, was searched by J.S. Pitts, D.S.I. Shih S Chien
Special Branch, and D.S. MacAdie and C.D.S. 316, but nothing
incriminating was found. It was learned that the room had
been engaged by one Lee Ts Ching one month ago. The room was
empty at the time of the visit. According to Lieu Loo Ying,
he also visited the room 630 on the evening of February 22,
1937, and stayed the night.

As already remarked General Yang Hu was unaware of the
order for the arrest of Lieu Loo Ying. Consequently when
Supt. Tan Shao Liang telephoned to him at the request of
C.D.I. Ross at about 3 a.m. the former was told by General
Yang Hu that he was unaware of the existence of such a
warrant. Apparently however Colonel Wong of the Garrison,
seeing that the affair had become public, went to Yang Hu's house
in the French Concession and explained the casebecause at
4.30 a.m. on February 24, when D.S.I. Shih S Chien telephoned to
the Garrison Commander at his home he said that a secret
order was in existence and at 5.40 a.m. sent over by Inspector
Hsu Bang Fi an order to Colonel Wong to arrest Lieu Loo Ying,
chopped by himself.

Mr. T. Robertson, D.O."A", was kept informed of the
situation and gave instructions that should an order for
Lieu Loo Ying's arrest be forthcoming that he be placed
on a Writ of Detention.

( Sd ) M.C.Young
Deputy Commissioner
(Crime Branch)

所有在场人员都被带到捕房。1937年2月24日凌晨3时，特科的施士珍副督察（D.S.I. Shih S Chien）、麦阿迪副督察和刑事侦缉高级警员316号搜查了刘芦隐曾到访的扬子饭店630房间，但未发现任何罪证。据悉，该房间是一个月前由李子清预订的。刘到访时房间是空的。据刘芦隐称，他也在1937年2月22日晚上去过630房间并过夜。

如前所述，杨虎将军并不知道逮捕刘芦隐的命令。因此，当罗斯首席督察（C.D.I. Ross）要求谭绍良警司在凌晨3点左右打电话给他时，前者被告知杨虎将军不知道存在此类逮捕令。然而，卫戍部的王上校见事态公开化，便前往杨虎在法租界的住所解释案情，因为在2月24日凌晨4时30分，当施士珍副督察打电话给在家中的卫戍司令时，他说存在一项秘密命令，并于上午5时40分由徐邦斐督察送来一份由他自己盖章的命令，指示王上校逮捕刘芦隐。

“A”区警务处长T. Robertson先生随时掌握局势，并指示如果发出逮捕刘芦隐的命令，应对其签发拘留令。

（签名）M.C. Young
副总监
（刑事处）

至 Smir. 1937年2月26日 /3。

STATEMENT OF FACTS CONCERNING THE
ATTEMPTED ILLEGAL ARREST IN THE SETTLEMENT OF
Lieo Loo Ying (刘藎隐) and his wife Lieu Hwa Ss
(刘華氏 ) by detectives attached to the Garrison
Commissioner's Headquarters on February 24, 1937.
------------------------------------

At 1.50 a.m. 24-2-37, Detective Tse Yu Sing
(朱又新) attached to the Garrison Commissioner's
Headquarters, Lunghwa, came to the Station and requested
assistance in bringing two alleged communists from the
Yangtse Hotel on Yunnan Road.

D.S.362, R.W.MacAdie and C.D.S.316 immediately
attended and found that Detectives Sung Tsai (沈醉)
and Tung Mow Yi (程茂頤) attached to the same
quarters had arrested one Lieu Loo Ying (刘藎隐)
his wife Lieu Hwa Ss (刘華氏), while about to
their motor car, S.M.C. License No.1847.

Enquiries ascertained that at about 1.30 a.m.
24-2-37, the three detectives mentioned observed L
Ying's chauffeur with the car outside the Yangtse
on Yunnan Road and had waited for Lieu to come out. When
Lieu emerged the detectives produced pistols and told
Lieu to keep quiet and attempted to force him into the
Garrison's car No.6474 which was waiting on Yunnan Road.
Lieu however raised an alarm and O.P.C.692 on duty at
the Yangtse Hotel responded. They told O.P.C. 692 that
they were attached to "Special Headquarters" but refused
to produce their warrant cards. Detective Tse Yu Sing
(朱又新) then proceeded to the Louza Police Station
as recorded.

关于1937年2月24日驻防司令总部侦探在租界内企图非法逮捕刘藎隐（Lieo Loo Ying）及其妻刘華氏（Lieu Hwa Ss）的事实陈述。
------------------------------------

1937年2月24日凌晨1时50分，隶属龙华驻防司令总部的侦探朱又新（Tse Yu Sing）来到警局，请求协助从云南路扬子饭店带走两名涉嫌共产党分子。

副督察362号 R.W. MacAdie 和刑事侦探副督察316号 C.D.S. 立即前往现场，发现隶属于同一机构的侦探沈醉（Sung Tsai）和程茂頤（Tung Mow Yi）已逮捕刘藎隐（Lieu Loo Ying）及其妻刘華氏（Lieu Hwa Ss），当时二人正欲进入其汽车（工部局牌照第1847号）。

经查询获悉，1937年2月24日凌晨1时30分左右，上述三名侦探在云南路扬子饭店外观察到刘藎隐的司机与车辆，并等待刘出来。当刘出现时，侦探们亮出手枪，命令刘保持安静，并试图将其强行带上停在云南路的驻防司令部第6474号汽车。然而刘大声呼救，正在扬子饭店执勤的巡长692号（O.P.C.692）随即响应。侦探们告诉巡长692号他们隶属于“特别总部”，但拒绝出示证件。随后，侦探朱又新（Tse Yu Sing）按记录前往老闸捕房。

- 2 -

Brought to the Station, Lieu Loo Ying, age 44,
native of Kiangse, stated that he was a member of the
C.E.C, of the Kuomintang and for many years chief of
the Propaganda Department of the Nanking Government.
He also stated that he was a close follower of the late
Hu Han Min (胡漢民), well known politician.

A few minutes after Lieu and his wife had been
brought to the Station Inspectors Hsu Bang Yi (许鹏飛)
and Yang Vung Kyi (杨凤岐) attended and stated that Lieu
and his wife were wanted on a secret order from Nanking
received by the Garrison Commissioner's Headquarters on
22.2.37. According to the secret order Lieu and his
wife were implicated as being concerned in the assassina-
tions of Yang Yoong Tai (杨永泰), Governor of Hupeh, in
November 1936 in Hankow and Tang Yu Jen (唐有壬), Vice
Minister of Foreign Affairs, on Rue Gaston Kahn, F.C. in
1935.

At 4.30 a.m. 24.2.37 the Special Branch (S.M.P.)
ascertained from General Yang Hu (杨虎) that a
secret order from Nanking was actually in existence for
the arrest of Lieu Loo Ying (刘蘆隱) and at 5.40 a.m.
24.2.37 an instruction from General Yang Hu to Col. Wong
of the Garrison to arrest Lieu Loo Ying (刘蘆隱) was
brought to Louza Station by representatives of the Garrison
Commissioner's Headquarters. The wife of Lieu Loo Ying
was not mentioned in the order and she was released.
Lieu Loo Ying (刘隱) will be brought before the
Shanghai Special District Court on a writ of Detention.
pages.zh:
- 2 -

刘藎隐被带至警局后，自述现年44岁，江西人，系国民党中执委成员，并多年担任南京政府宣传部部长。他还声称自己是已故著名政治家胡漢民（Hu Han Min）的亲信追随者。

刘及其妻子被带到警局几分钟后，督察许鹏飛（Hsu Bang Yi）和杨凤岐（Yang Vung Kyi）赶到，称刘及其妻子系根据驻防司令总部于1937年2月22日收到的来自南京的秘密命令而被通缉。根据该秘密命令，刘及其妻子涉嫌参与1936年11月在汉口刺杀湖北省主席杨永泰（Yang Yoong Tai）以及1935年在法租界贾尔业爱路（Rue Gaston Kahn）刺杀外交部次长唐有壬（Tang Yu Jen）的案件。

1937年2月24日凌晨4时30分，警务处政治部（Special Branch, S.M.P.）从杨虎（Yang Hu）将军处核实，确实存在一份逮捕刘蘆隱（Lieu Loo Ying）的南京秘密命令；1937年2月24日凌晨5时40分，驻防司令总部代表将杨虎将军致驻防军黄上校（Col. Wong）逮捕刘蘆隱（Lieu Loo Ying）的指令送至老闸捕房。该命令中未提及刘藎隐之妻，故将其释放。刘藎隐（刘隱）将凭拘留令被提解至上海特区法院受审。

D.C. Crime

Please let me have draft of facts for Secretary-
General. I shall add my view.
No one can be arrested in the Settlement except
by the S.M.Police on their own authority or the
authority of a warrant issued by the 1st S.D.Court.
Please get someone to impress this on the
Garrison Commander's HQs and inform them that if such
independent functioning is attempted by their detectives
again, I shall order the detectives to be locked up and
detained till a guarantee given that such action will
not be taken again.

F.W.G.

刑事犯罪副总监

请为我准备一份事实草案供秘书长使用。我将附上我的意见。
除工部局警察依其自身职权或依据第一特区法院签发的逮捕令外，任何人不得在租界内被捕。
请派人向驻防司令总部强调这一点，并告知他们，如果其侦探再次尝试此类独立行动，我将命令将该等侦探关押拘留，直至其提供保证不再采取此类行动为止。

F.W.G.
2月24日

Subject Arrest of Liu Lu Ying (劉蘆隱).

Made by and Forwarded by Supt. Tan Shao Liang

The arrest of Liu Lu Ying is reported to have been
based on a statement made by one Siao Za Hsu (蕭若虛) who,
according to Chinese Authorities, was arrested at the house of
Yang Hsu Chien (楊爾謙) in Route Delastre, French Concession.
The French Police have no record of the arrest but received
about four months ago an application from Soong Wu Detectives
to raid a house of Yang Hsu Chien but found the latter had
absconded. Siao is said to have alleged that he had been
to the house of Liu Lu Ying in Hongkong where he received
instructions to proceed to Shanghai to warn Yang to return to
Hongkong.

Jadhwani
Superintendent.

Date February 24, 19 37.
Subject Arrest of Lieu Leh Ying ( 劉蘆隱 )
Made by and Forwarded by D.S.I. Coyne

（左侧手写批注：x name mentioned in file A 7652）

With reference to the arrest of Lieu Loh-ying
at the request of the Woosung-Shanghai Garrison Commander's
Office, according to the person responsible for the arrest,
he received a telegram from General Chiang Kai Shek at
11.30 p.m. February 23, instructing him to effect the
arrest immediately.

Not knowing where the wanted man might be located,
agents were sent to cover hotels and other likely places in
the Settlement, the French Concession and Chinese controlled
territory. It was only after Lieu had been located that
General Yang Hu was informed and asked to issue the necessary
warrant, hence the reason he knew nothing of the matter when
first communicated with by the Municipal Police.

The informant stated that Lieu had been in Nanking
with the object of forming a party to oppose the present
Government, but meeting with no success, and realizing that
his movements were being watched, he left for Shanghai with
the intention of returning to Hongkong on the s.s.
"President Hoover."

Documents seized by the Hongkong Police when
Wong Ying San, a follower of Wong Yah Jao, was arrested,
were found to have been written by Lieu. These documents,
which were handed over to the Chinese Authorities when the
prisoners were extradited, revealed a plot hatched by Lieu
to assassinate certain Government officials alleged to be
pro-Japanese.

Photographs of some of these documents are to be
published in the Press, the object being to show the
public that the arrest was not made with any ulterior

档案号........... 7809
政治部特别督察 1937年2月25日
报告
日期 1937年2月24日。
主题：逮捕刘蘆隱（Lieu Leh Ying / 劉蘆隱）
由特别督察科因（D.S.I. Coyne）制作并提交

（左侧手写批注：x 名字在档案 A 7652 中提到）

关于应吴淞-上海驻防司令办公室要求逮捕刘洛英（Lieu Loh-ying）一事，据负责逮捕的人员称，他于2月23日晚上11时30分收到蒋介石将军的电报，指示他立即执行逮捕。

由于不知通缉犯可能藏身何处，便派遣特工覆盖租界、法租界及华界内的旅馆和其他可能地点。直到找到刘之后，才通知杨虎将军并请其签发必要的逮捕令，这就是为何工部局警察初次联系时他对此事一无所知的原因。

线人称，刘曾前往南京，意图组建一个反对现政府的党派，但未获成功，且意识到自己的行动受到监视，便前往上海，打算乘坐“胡佛总统号”轮船返回香港。

在香港警方逮捕王亚樵（Wong Yah Jao）的追随者王英三（Wong Ying San）时搜获的文件中，发现部分文件系由刘撰写。这些文件在引渡囚犯时移交给了中国当局，揭露了刘策划刺杀某些被指亲日的政府官员的阴谋。

其中一些文件的照片将在报刊上发表，目的是向公众表明，此次逮捕并非出于任何不可告人的

（左侧手写批注：DC(Cn)）
